```{r loadlib, echo=TRUE}
my_theme <- function(base_theme) {
  base_theme() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "montserrat"), # Base for everything
    axis.text = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),

    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold.italic"),

    legend.title = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold") # Facet labels
  )
}
```

Print all the means and SD reported in main text
```{r sumstat_ms, eval=FALSE}

stats_dataset <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "stats_dataset_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus_perctpfp_picrustrecall_mds_perm_cor_alpha2_beta_da2_z.rds"))

find_cols <- function(data, patterns) {
  Reduce(function(cols, pat) cols[grepl(pat, cols)], patterns, init = colnames(data))
}

getsum <- function(df, dats, var) {
  df_sub <- lapply(dats, function(d) {
    vars <- find_cols(df[[d]], var)
    df[[d]] %>% select(pipeline, all_of(vars)) %>% 
      mutate(dataset = d)
  }) %>% bind_rows()

  sum_d <- df_sub %>% 
    group_by(dataset) %>% 
    summarize(across(where(is.numeric), list(mean = ~ mean(., na.rm=TRUE), sd = ~ sd(., na.rm=TRUE)), .names = "{.col}_{.fn}")) %>%
    data.frame() %>%
    column_to_rownames("dataset")

  data.frame(t(sum_d)) %>% print()

  sum_a <- sum_d %>% colMeans() %>% data.frame()
  print(sum_a)
}
```

Summary statistics for classifier and db concordance 
```{r conc_ms, eval=FALSE}

# Concordance (genus)
alloverlaps <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "concordance_taxonomy.rds"))
concordance <- alloverlaps$concordance
conc_sub <- concordance %>% 
  filter(comb %in% c("def_q2", "def_idtaxa", "q2_idtaxa")) %>%
  select(-c(na1, na2, partial, mismatch)) %>%
  group_by(comb, dataset) %>% 
  summarize(across(c(phylum, class, order, family, genus), list(avg = ~mean(.x, na.rm=TRUE),
                                                              sd = ~sd(.x, na.rm=TRUE))))

print(data.frame(conc_sub))

conc_a <- conc_sub %>% 
  group_by(comb) %>% 
  select(-dataset) %>% 
  summarize(across(where(is.numeric), list(avg = ~mean(.x, na.rm=TRUE))))

print(conc_a)

conc_a %>% select(comb, all_of(contains("genus"))) %>% 
  mutate(cl = ifelse(grepl("def", comb), "def", "harm")) %>%
  group_by(cl) %>% 
  summarize(across(where(is.numeric), list(avg = ~mean(.x, na.rm=TRUE)))) %>% 
  print()
```

```{r fig3, eval=FALSE}
stats_dataset <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "stats_dataset_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus_perctpfp_picrustrecall_mds_perm_cor_alpha2_beta_da2_z.rds"))

# ASV yield
df_sub <- lapply(datasets$datasets, function(d) {
  vars <- c("pipeline", "asv")
  if (d %in% reals) {
    vars <- c(vars, "distave_jaccard_asv249", "cor_clr_asv249")
  } else {
    vars <- c(vars, "distexp_jaccard_asv_exp", "cor_clr_exp_asv")
  }

  tmp <- stats_dataset[[d]] %>% select(all_of(vars)) %>% 
    mutate(dataset = d)

  colnames(tmp) <- c("pipeline", "asv", "dist", "cor", "dataset")
  tmp$dist <- 1 - tmp$dist # convert to similarity
  return(tmp)
}) %>% bind_rows() 

df_sub <- df_sub %>% 
    add_row(data.frame(dataset = "mock5", pipeline = "Expected", asv = 61)) %>%
    add_row(data.frame(dataset = "mock12", pipeline = "Expected", asv = 61)) %>%
    add_row(data.frame(dataset = "miseq_v4_sim", pipeline = "Expected", asv = 2191)) %>%
    add_row(data.frame(dataset = "novaseq_v4_sim", pipeline = "Expected", asv = 2191)) %>%
    mutate(dataset = factor(dataset, levels = datasets$datasets),
           pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = pipelines, labels = pipelines_l))

        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +

}

# False positives
df_fp <- lapply(c(mocks, sims), function(d) {
  fps[[d]][[lev]] %>%
    mutate(dataset = d)
}) %>% bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(spec = ifelse(tp %in% "TP", "True Positive", "False Positive")) %>%
  select(-c(tp, specific)) %>% 
  filter(dataset %in% c(mocks, sims)) %>% 
  mutate(dataset = factor(dataset, levels = datasets$datasets, labels = titles_d))  

df_spec <- lapply(c(reals), function(d) {
  fps[[d]][[lev]] %>%
    mutate(dataset = d)
}) %>% bind_rows() %>% 
  mutate(spec = ifelse(specific == 1, "Specific", "Shared")) %>%
  select(-c(tp, specific)) %>% 
  filter(dataset %in% reals) %>% 
  mutate(dataset = factor(dataset, levels = datasets$datasets, labels = titles_d))  

df_comb <- rbind(df_fp, df_spec) %>%
  mutate(spec = factor(spec, levels = c("True Positive", "False Positive", "Shared", "Specific"))) %>% 
  mutate(tp = ifelse(spec %in% c("True Positive", "Shared"), "TP / Shared", "FP / Specific")) %>%
  mutate(tp = factor(tp, levels = c("TP / Shared", "FP / Specific"))) %>%
  mutate(dtype = ifelse(dataset %in% c(mocks, sims), "Ground truth", "Consensus"))

pos <- c("True Positive" = 1, "False Positive" = 1.80, 
         "Shared"        = 3, "Specific"       = 3.80) 

df_comb <- rbind(df_fp, df_spec) %>%
  mutate(
    xpos = pos[as.character(spec)],
    tp   = factor(ifelse(spec %in% c("True Positive", "Shared"), "TP / Shared", "FP / Specific"),
                  levels = c("TP / Shared", "FP / Specific"))
  )

p3 <- ggplot(df_comb, aes(x = xpos, y = ab, group = spec, fill = tp, color = tp)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5, outliers = FALSE, coef = Inf, width = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("TP / Shared" = "#6866f1ff", "FP / Specific" = "#f78d37ff")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = c("TP / Shared" = "#6866f1ff", "FP / Specific" = "#f78d37ff")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = pos,
                     labels = c("True positive", "False positive", "Shared (2+ pipelines)", "Specific (1 pipeline)"),
                     expand = expansion(add = 0.5)) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  annotate("text", x = c(1.425, 3.425), y = Inf, vjust = 1.1, size = 2.4,family = "Montserrat Light",
         label = c("Ground truth", "Consensus")) +
  my_theme(theme_classic) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "lightgrey", linewidth = 0.05)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "log10(relative abundance)", title = "Abundance") +
  guides(fill = "none", color = "none")

p4 <- ggplot(df_comb, aes(x = xpos, y = prev, group = spec, fill = tp, color = tp)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5, outliers = FALSE, coef = Inf, width = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("TP / Shared" = "#6866f1ff", "FP / Specific" = "#f78d37ff")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = c("TP / Shared" = "#6866f1ff", "FP / Specific" = "#f78d37ff")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = pos,
                     labels = c("True positive", "False positive", "Shared", "Specific"),
                     expand = expansion(add = 0.5)) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  annotate("text", x = c(1.425, 3.425), y = Inf, vjust = 1.1, size = 2.4, family = "Montserrat Light",
         label = c("Ground truth", "Consensus")) +
  my_theme(theme_classic) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "lightgrey", linewidth = 0.05)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "log10(prevalence)", title = "Prevalence") +
  guides(fill = "none", color = "none")

p34 <- p3 + p4 +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "none")
 
# Combine

  plot_layout(widths = c(0.666, 0.333))
r2 <- (pltlist[["avg_recallrate"]] | pltlist[["avg_precisionrate"]] | p34 ) +

      plot_layout(widths = c(0.225, 0.275, 0.225, 0.275))
```

```{r fig4, eval=FALSE}
          legend.position = "right",
          legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 7),

# Performance by  Reference Database
# Performance of classifiers (with silva)
df_sub3 <- lapply(datasets$datasets, function(d) {
  var_select <- c("pipeline")
  
  var_select <- c(var_select,
                  paste0("distave_jaccard_", c(classifiers, "q2_gg", "idtaxa_gg", "deftax")),
                  paste0("cor_clr_", c(classifiers, "q2_gg", "idtaxa_gg", "deftax")))

  var_select <- var_select[var_select %in% colnames(stats_dataset[[d]])]

  stats_dataset[[d]] %>% 
    select(all_of(var_select)) %>%
    mutate(dataset = d)

}) %>% bind_rows() 

df_long3 <- df_sub3 %>%
  filter(!pipeline %in% "LotuS2_otu") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(pipeline, dataset), names_to="variable", values_to="value") %>%
  mutate(variable2 = case_when(grepl("dist", variable) ~ "dist",
                              grepl("cor", variable) ~ "cor",
                              grepl("recall", variable) ~ "recall",
                              grepl("precision", variable) ~ "precision")) %>% 
  mutate(classifier = case_when(grepl("_q2", variable) ~ "q2",
                                grepl("_idtaxa", variable) ~ "idtaxa",
                                grepl("_deftax", variable) ~ "def"),
         reference = case_when(grepl("_gg", variable) ~ "GreenGenes",
                                TRUE ~ "Silva"),
         var = case_when(variable2 %in% "dist" ~ "Jaccard",
                         variable2 %in% "cor" ~ "Correlation",
                         variable2 %in% "recall" ~ "Recall",
                         TRUE ~ "Precision"),
         dtype = case_when(dataset %in% mocks ~ "Mock",
                           dataset %in% sims ~ "Simulation",
                           dataset %in% reals ~ "Real")) %>%
        mutate(dtype = factor(dtype, levels = c("Mock", "Simulation", "Real"))) %>%
        mutate(var = factor(var, levels = c("Recall", "Precision", "Jaccard", "Correlation")))

# convert to similarity
df_long3$value[df_long3$variable2 %in% "dist"] <- 1 - df_long3$value[df_long3$variable2 %in% "dist"]

p9 <- df_long3 %>%
  filter(!var %in% c("Precision", "Recall")) %>% 
  mutate(reference = factor(reference, levels = c("Silva", "GreenGenes"))) %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = var, y = value, color = reference, fill = reference)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7,coef=Inf) +
    my_theme(theme_classic) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Silva" = "#372929ff", "GreenGenes" = "#d02228ff")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Silva" = "#372929ff", "GreenGenes" = "#d02228ff")) +
    labs(x = "", y = "Metric", title = "Performance by Reference Database") +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
          panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "#EAEAEA", linewidth = 0.1))

df_long3 %>%

  group_by(reference, var) %>% 
  summarize(avg = mean(value, na.rm=TRUE),
            sd = sd(value, na.rm=TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(var, reference)
``` 

```{r fig5, eval=FALSE}
        } else {
            vars <- c(vars, paste0("distexp_jaccard_", lev), paste0("cor_clr_exp_", lev))
        }

        tmp <- stats_dataset[[d]] %>% select(all_of(vars)) %>% 
            mutate(dataset = d)

        return(tmp)
    }) %>% bind_rows() 
    
    df_var <- df_sub %>%

        mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = pipelines, pipelines_l)) %>%

  df_avg <- df_sub2 %>%

          my_theme(theme_classic) +
          theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
              panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "lightgrey", linewidth = 0.05),
              plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
          ylim(c(0,1)) +
          scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05)), limits = c(0, NA)) +
          labs(x = "", y=titles_var[[var]], title = titles_var[[var]]) +
          guides(fill = "none", color = "none")

  }

  # Plot FP abundances
  fps <- readRDS(paste0(output_path, "abundance_distributions.rds"))

  tit_lev <- c("asv" = "ASV-level", "q2" = "Genus-level (q2)", "idtaxa" = "Genus-level (IDTAXA)")
  # lev <- "q2"

  # False positives
  df_fp <- lapply(c(mocks, sims), function(d) {
    fps[[d]][[lev]] %>%
      mutate(dataset = d)
  }) %>% bind_rows() %>%
    mutate(spec = ifelse(tp %in% "TP", "True Positive", "False Positive")) %>%
    select(-c(tp, specific)) %>% 
    filter(dataset %in% sims) %>% 
    mutate(dataset = factor(dataset, levels = datasets$datasets, labels = titles_d))  

  df_spec <- lapply(c(reals), function(d) {
    fps[[d]][[lev]] %>%
      mutate(dataset = d)
  }) %>% bind_rows() %>% 
    mutate(spec = ifelse(specific == 1, "Specific", "Shared")) %>%
    select(-c(tp, specific)) %>% 
    filter(dataset %in% reals) %>% 
    mutate(dataset = factor(dataset, levels = datasets$datasets, labels = titles_d))  

  pos <- c("True Positive" = 1, "False Positive" = 1.80, 
          "Shared"        = 3, "Specific"       = 3.80) 

  df_comb <- rbind(df_fp, df_spec) %>%
    mutate(
      xpos = pos[as.character(spec)],
      tp   = factor(ifelse(spec %in% c("True Positive", "Shared"), "TP / Shared", "FP / Specific"),
                    levels = c("TP / Shared", "FP / Specific"))
    )

  p3 <- ggplot(df_comb, aes(x = xpos, y = ab, group = spec, fill = tp, color = tp)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5, outliers = FALSE, coef = Inf, width = 0.7) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("TP / Shared" = "#6866f1ff", "FP / Specific" = "#f78d37ff")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values  = c("TP / Shared" = "#6866f1ff", "FP / Specific" = "#f78d37ff")) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = pos,
                      labels = c("True positive", "False positive", "Shared", "Specific"),
                      expand = expansion(add = 0.5)) +
    scale_y_log10() +
    annotate("text", x = c(1.425, 3.425), y = Inf, vjust = 1.1, size = 2.4,family = "Montserrat Light",
          label = c("Ground truth", "Consensus")) +
    my_theme(theme_classic) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
          panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "lightgrey", linewidth = 0.05)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "log10(relative abundance)", title = "Abundance") +
    guides(fill = "none", color = "none")

  p4 <- ggplot(df_comb, aes(x = xpos, y = prev, group = spec, fill = tp, color = tp)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5, outliers = FALSE, coef = Inf, width = 0.7) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("TP / Shared" = "#6866f1ff", "FP / Specific" = "#f78d37ff")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values  = c("TP / Shared" = "#6866f1ff", "FP / Specific" = "#f78d37ff")) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = pos,
                      labels = c("True positive", "False positive", "Shared", "Specific"),
                      expand = expansion(add = 0.5)) +
    scale_y_log10() +
    annotate("text", x = c(1.425, 3.425), y = Inf, vjust = 1.1, size = 2.4, family = "Montserrat Light",
          label = c("Ground truth", "Consensus")) +
    my_theme(theme_classic) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
          panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "lightgrey", linewidth = 0.05)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "log10(prevalence)", title = "Prevalence") +
    guides(fill = "none", color = "none")

  p34 <- p3 + p4 +
    plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
    theme(legend.position = "none")
  
    # Combine 
    r1 <- (p1 | p2) +
        plot_layout(widths = c(0.666, 0.333))
    r2 <- (pltlist[["avg_recallrate"]] | pltlist[["avg_precisionrate"]] | p34 ) +
        plot_layout(widths = c(1/3, 1/3, 1/3)) +
        theme(axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10)))
    r3 <- (pltlist[["avg_dist"]] | pltlist[["avg_dist_pairs"]] | pltlist[["avg_cor"]] | pltlist[["avg_cor_pairs"]]) +
        plot_layout(widths = c(0.225, 0.275, 0.225, 0.275))

    combined <- (r1 / r2 / r3) + 
            plot_layout(heights = c(1/3, 1/3, 1/3),
                        guides = "collect") &
            theme(legend.position = "bottom",
                legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
                legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
                legend.key.width = unit(0.3, "cm"),
                legend.key.height = unit(0.4, "cm"))

    ggsave(paste0(plot_path, "Figure5_", lev, ".pdf"), plot =  combined, device = cairo_pdf, width = 12, height = 10)

}
```

```{r fig5_picrust, eval=FALSE}
for (lev in c("KO", "cyc")) {

      ) +

      labs(x = "", y = paste0("# ", lev, "s"), title = paste0(lev, " Count: Simulation / Real"))

    df_avg <- df_sub2 %>% 
      group_by(dataset) %>% 
      summarize(avg = mean(num, na.rm=TRUE)) 

    df_dev <- df_avg %>%

    tmp <- df_dev %>% mutate(perc_diff = perc_diff * 100) %>% group_by(dataset) %>% summarize(mean_diff = mean(abs(perc_diff), na.rm=TRUE))
    tmp %>% print()
    tmp %>% summarize(mean = mean(mean_diff, na.rm=TRUE)) %>% data.frame()  %>% print()

  df_dev %>% group_by(pipeline) %>% mutate(perc_diff = perc_diff * 100) %>% summarize(mean_diff = mean(perc_diff))
    
  p2 <- df_dev %>%

        pltlist[[paste0("avg_", var)]] <- ggplot(data=df_var, aes(x = pipeline, y = .data[[var]])) +

    #  Jaccard and Correlation (corplot)

        guides(fill = "none", color = "none") +

    # Combine 
    r1 <- p1 | p2
    r2 <- (pltlist[["avg_recallrate"]] | pltlist[["avg_precisionrate"]] | pltlist[["scatter"]] ) +
        plot_layout(widths = c(1/3, 1/3, 1/3)) +
        theme(axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10)))
    r3 <- (pltlist[["avg_dist"]] | pltlist[["avg_dist_pairs"]] | pltlist[["avg_cor"]] | pltlist[["avg_cor_pairs"]]) +
        plot_layout(widths = c(0.225, 0.275, 0.225, 0.275))

    combined <- (r1 / r2 / r3) + 
            plot_layout(heights = c(1/3, 1/3, 1/3),
                        guides = "collect") &
            theme(legend.position = "bottom",
                legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
                legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
                legend.key.width = unit(0.3, "cm"),
                legend.key.height = unit(0.4, "cm"))

    ggsave(paste0(plot_path, "Figure5_", lev, ".pdf"), plot =  combined, device = cairo_pdf, width = 12, height = 10)

}
```

```{r fig6, eval=FALSE}
df_prop <- lapply(c(reals), function(d) {

# Precision / recall
df_sub <- lapply(sims, function(d) {
  stats_dataset[[d]] %>% select(pipeline, da_recall_q2, da_precision_q2) %>%
  mutate(dataset = d)
}) %>% bind_rows() %>%
  filter(!pipeline %in% "LotuS2_otu")

plts <- lapply(c("da_recall_q2", "da_precision_q2"), function(var) { 
  if (grepl("recall", var)) {
    ylab <- "Recall"
    mytitle <- "DA Recall"
  } else {
     ylab <- "Precision"
     mytitle <- "DA Precision"
  }
  
  df_sub %>%
    mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = pipelines, labels = pipelines_l)) %>% 
    ggplot(., aes(x = pipeline, y = .data[[var]])) +
      stat_summary(fun = "mean", geom = "bar", alpha = 0.5, position = position_dodge(0.9), color ="#D3D3D3", fill="#D3D3D3") +
      geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 1, position = position_dodge(0.5), shape=17,
                aes(fill = dataset, color = dataset)) + 
      my_theme(theme_classic) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
            panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "#EAEAEA", linewidth = 0.1),
            plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5)) +
      labs(x = "", y = ylab, title = mytitle) +
      scale_color_manual(values = cols_d) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = cols_d) +
      scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.05)), limits=c(NA, 1)) +
      guides(fill = "none", color = "none")
})

# Combine 
r1 <- (p1 | p2| p3 | p4) +
      plot_layout(widths = c(0.15, 0.35, 0.15, 0.35))
r2 <- (p5 | plts[[1]] | plts[[2]])
r3 <- (p7  | p6 | p8 | p9) +
      plot_layout(widths = c(0.28, 0.28, 0.28, 0.16))

combined <- (r1 / r2 / r3) +
      plot_layout(heights = c(1/3, 1/3, 1/3),
                          guides = "collect") &
      theme(legend.position = "bottom",
            legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
            legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
            legend.key.width = unit(0.3, "cm"),
            legend.key.height = unit(0.4, "cm"))

ggsave(paste0(plot_path, "Figure6.pdf"), plot = combined, device = cairo_pdf, width = 10, height = 9)
```

```{r fig7, eval=FALSE}
# Heatmap per feature category
df_feat2 <- df_all %>% 
  filter(!grepl("recall|precision", variable)) %>% 
  mutate(metric_base = variable %>% 
           str_remove("_q2$")) %>% 
  # Average across avs and genus level 
  mutate(metric_base = metric_base %>% 
           str_remove("_asv$")) %>% 
  group_by(pipeline, dataset, metric_base) %>%
  summarize(value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  # remove ave/exp extensions
  mutate(metric_base = metric_base %>%
           str_remove("_exp$") %>%
           str_remove("_ave$")) %>%
  # Average across alpha metrics (shannon, observed) and across beta metrics (aitchison, jaccard)
  mutate(metric_base = metric_base %>%
          str_replace("_alpha_shannon", "_alpha") %>%
          str_replace("_alpha_observed", "_alpha") %>%
          str_replace("_beta_jaccard", "_beta") %>%
          str_replace("_beta_aitchison", "_beta")) %>%
  group_by(pipeline, dataset, metric_base) %>%
  summarize(value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  # Create variable type identifier
  mutate(vtype = sapply(str_split(metric_base, "_"), head, 1)) %>%
  group_by(pipeline, dataset, vtype) %>%
  summarize(value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

    scale_color_manual(values = cols_d, labels = titles_d) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cols_d, labels = titles_d) +
    ylim(c(-3,2.3))

# Plot by feature level (asv vs genus) 
df_feat <- lapply(datasets$dataset, function(d) {  
   df <- stats_comb[["feat_zscore"]][[d]] %>%
     pivot_longer(-c(pipeline, featlevel), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>% 
     mutate(group = sapply(str_split(variable, "_"), head, 1)) %>%
     mutate(dataset = d)
}) %>% bind_rows() %>%
  filter(!variable %in% "sim_cor_clr_exp") %>% 
  filter(!variable %in% "sim_cor_clr_exp") %>%

                           dataset %in% reals ~ "Real")) %>%
  mutate(dtype = factor(dtype, levels = c("Mock", "Simulation", "Real")),
         vtype = sapply(str_split(variable, "_"), head, 1),
         ctype = case_when(grepl("q2", variable) ~ "q2",
                           grepl("idtaxa", variable) ~ "idtaxa",
                           grepl("asv", variable) ~ "asv",
                           TRUE ~ "stats")) %>%
  mutate(featlevel = ifelse(featlevel %in% "ASV", "ASV", "Genus"))

df_feat_level <- df_feat %>%

  mutate(dtype = case_when(dataset %in% mocks ~ "Mock",
                           dataset %in% sims ~ "Simulation",
                           dataset %in% reals ~ "Real")) %>%
  mutate(dtype = factor(dtype, levels = c("Mock", "Simulation", "Real")))   

p6 <- ggplot(data = df_feat_level, aes(x = featlevel, y = value)) +
```

wb <- createWorkbook()

for (d in datasets$datasets) {

  sub <- stats_dataset[[d]] %>%
    select(-matches("^perc_(phylum|class|order|family|genus)"),
    -starts_with("corpart_"),
    -starts_with("perm_"),
    -starts_with("da_stat_"),
    -contains("_1mm"),

    -starts_with("distave_aitchison"),

  if (d %in% c(mocks, sims)) {
    sub <- sub %>%
      select(
        -c(
          asv_tp, genus_tp_q2, genus_tp_idtaxa,
          perc_fp, perc_fp_q2, perc_fp_idtaxa,

        ),

        recall_abundance             = tp_perc_recall,
        precision_abundance_q2       = perc_tp_precision_q2,
        precision_abundance_idtaxa   = perc_tp_precision_idtaxa,
        recall_abundance_q2          = tp_perc_gen_recall_q2,
        recall_abundance_idtaxa      = tp_perc_gen_recall_idtaxa
      )
  }

```{r stats_table, eval=FALSE}

stats_dataset <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "stats_dataset_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus_perctpfp_picrustrecall.rds"))
s_full <- data.frame(pipeline = pipelines) # %>% arrange(pipeline)

for (d in datasets$datasets) {

  # if (d %in% c("mock12", "gemsim", "novaseq_v4_sim")) n="3d"; next
  n="all"

  s <- stats_dataset[[d]] %>%
    select(pipeline, readslost=reads_lost, singletons, sparsity, readlength=read_length) %>%
    # mutate(singletons = singletons / asv * 100) %>%
    arrange(pipeline)

  colnames(s) <- c("pipeline", paste0(colnames(s)[-1], "_", d))

  s_full <- dplyr::left_join(s_full, s, by = "pipeline")

}

df <- s_full %>% arrange(tolower(pipeline))

# Dynamically identify unique variables (by splitting at "_ds") and datasets
variables <- c("readslost", "sparsity", "readlength", "singletons")
perc <- c("readslost", "sparsity")
integers <- c("singletons")

col_vars <- colnames(s_full)[-1]  # all columns except 'pipeline'	

gt_tbl <- gt(s_full) %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Pipeline statistics across datasets**")
  )

for (var in variables) {
  # Find all columns for this variable (matching pattern)
  cols_for_var <- grep(paste0("^", var, "_"), names(s_full), value = TRUE)
  # Clean variable name for label (optional: beautify underscores, % etc.)
  pretty_lab <- case_when(
    var == "readslost" ~ "Reads Lost (%)",
    var == "sparsity" ~ "Sparsity (% Zeros)",
    var == "singletons" ~ "Singletons (n)",
    var == "readlength" ~ "Read Length (median [min-max])",
    var == "asv" ~ "ASVs (n)",
    TRUE ~ var
  )
  gt_tbl <- gt_tbl %>%
    tab_spanner(
      label = pretty_lab,
      columns = all_of(cols_for_var))

  if (var %in% perc) {
    gt_tbl <- gt_tbl %>%
      fmt_percent(
        columns = all_of(cols_for_var),
        decimals = 2,
        scale_values = FALSE)
  } else if (var %in% integers) {
    gt_tbl <- gt_tbl %>%
      fmt_number(
        columns = all_of(cols_for_var),
        decimals = 0)
  }

  if (grep(var, variables) %% 2 == 1) {
  gt_tbl <- gt_tbl %>%
      tab_style(
        style = cell_fill(color = "grey95"),  # light shade 
        locations = cells_body(columns = all_of(cols_for_var)))
  }
}

# Optionally, make dataset names lower column labels
dataset_labels <- str_replace(col_vars, "^[^_]+_", "")
pretty_lab <- case_when(
    dataset_labels == "mock5" ~ "Mock 5",
    dataset_labels == "mock12" ~ "Mock 12",
    dataset_labels == "gemsim" ~ "GEMSIM",

    dataset_labels == "novaseq_v4_sim" ~ "Sim (Novaseq)",
    TRUE ~ dataset_labels
  )

  cols_label(.list = col_label_map)
```

### Table with precision/recall
```{r tabprecisionrecall, eval=FALSE}

stats_dataset <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "stats_dataset_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus_perctpfp_picrustrecall.rds"))
stats_sample <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "stats_sample_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus_picrustrecall.rds"))

for (d in datasets$datasets[!datasets$datasets %in% reals]) {

  s1 <- lapply(pipelines, function(p) {
     if (!is.null(stats_sample[[d]][[p]])) {
       stats_sample[[d]][[p]] %>% 
            dplyr::select(all_of(contains("recall")), all_of(contains("precision"))) %>%
       summarise(across(everything(), list(mean = ~mean(. , na.rm=TRUE),
                                           sd = ~sd(. , na.rm=TRUE)),
                       .names = "{col}_{fn}")) %>%
       mutate(pipeline = p) %>% select(pipeline, everything())
     } else {
       NULL
     }
  }) %>% bind_rows()
 
  s2 <- stats_dataset[[d]] %>%
    select(pipeline, all_of(contains("perc")), all_of(contains("unassigned")), precisionrate, precisionrate_genus_q2, precisionrate_genus_idtaxa, recallrate, recallrate_genus_q2, recallrate_genus_idtaxa)

  s_full <- dplyr::left_join(s1, s2, by = "pipeline") # %>% arrange(pipeline)

  if (!d %in% "mock12") { # has only 1 sample, so no sd
    s_full <- s_full %>%
      mutate(precision_asv_dataset=paste0(round(precisionrate,2)),
            recall_asv_dataset=paste0(round(recallrate,2)),
            precision_gen_q2_dataset=paste0(round(precisionrate_genus_q2,2)),
            recall_gen_q2_dataset=paste0(round(recallrate_genus_q2,2)),
            precision_gen_idtaxa_dataset=paste0(round(precisionrate_genus_idtaxa,2)),
            recall_gen_idtaxa_dataset=paste0(round(recallrate_genus_idtaxa,2)),
            recall_asv = paste0(round(recallrate_mean, 2), " (", round(recallrate_sd, 2), ")"),
            precision_asv = paste0(round(precisionrate_mean, 2), " (", round(precisionrate_sd, 2), ")"),
            recall_asv_1mm = paste0(round(recallrate_1mm_mean, 2), " (", round(recallrate_1mm_sd, 2), ")"),
            precision_asv_1mm = paste0(round(precisionrate_1mm_mean, 2), " (", round(precisionrate_1mm_sd, 2), ")"),
            recall_gen_q2 = paste0(round(recall_gen_q2_mean, 2), " (", round(recall_gen_q2_sd, 2), ")"),
            precision_gen_q2 = paste0(round(precision_gen_q2_mean, 2), " (", round(precision_gen_q2_sd, 2), ")"), 
            recall_gen_idtaxa = paste0(round(recall_gen_idtaxa_mean, 2), " (", round(recall_gen_idtaxa_sd, 2), ")"),
            precision_gen_idtaxa = paste0(round(precision_gen_idtaxa_mean, 2), " (", round(precision_gen_idtaxa_sd, 2), ")"))
  } else {
    s_full <- s_full %>%
      mutate(precision_asv_dataset=paste0(round(precisionrate,2)),
            recall_asv_dataset=paste0(round(recallrate,2)),
            precision_gen_q2_dataset=paste0(round(precisionrate_genus_q2,2)),
            recall_gen_q2_dataset=paste0(round(recallrate_genus_q2,2)),
            precision_gen_idtaxa_dataset=paste0(round(precisionrate_genus_idtaxa,2)),
            recall_gen_idtaxa_dataset=paste0(round(recallrate_genus_idtaxa,2)),
            recall_asv = paste0(round(recallrate_mean, 2)),
            precision_asv = paste0(round(precisionrate_mean, 2)),
            recall_asv_1mm = paste0(round(recallrate_1mm_mean, 2)),
            precision_asv_1mm = paste0(round(precisionrate_1mm_mean, 2)),
            recall_gen_q2 = paste0(round(recall_gen_q2_mean, 2)),
            precision_gen_q2 = paste0(round(precision_gen_q2_mean, 2)), 
            recall_gen_idtaxa = paste0(round(recall_gen_idtaxa_mean, 2)),
            precision_gen_idtaxa = paste0(round(precision_gen_idtaxa_mean, 2)))
  }
  
  s_full <- s_full %>%  
    select(pipeline,
          # recall asv
          recall_asv_dataset=recall_asv_dataset,
          recall_asv=recall_asv,
          recall_asv_1mm=recall_asv_1mm,
          perc_asv_tp_recall=tp_perc_recall,
          perc_asv_fn_recall=fn_perc,
          # Precision asv
          precision_asv_dataset=precision_asv_dataset,
          precision_asv=precision_asv,
          precision_asv_1mm=precision_asv_1mm,
          perc_asv_tp_precision=perc_tp_precision,
          perc_asv_1mm_precision=perc_1mm_precision,
          perc_asv_fp_precision=perc_fp,
          # recall genus (q2)
          recall_gen_q2_dataset=recall_gen_q2_dataset,
          recall_gen_q2=recall_gen_q2,
          perc_gen_tp_recall_q2=tp_perc_gen_recall_q2,
          perc_gen_fn_recall_q2=fn_perc_gen_q2,
          # recall (genus idtaxa)
          recall_gen_idtaxa_dataset=recall_gen_idtaxa_dataset,
          recall_gen_idtaxa=recall_gen_idtaxa,
          perc_gen_tp_recall_idtaxa=tp_perc_gen_recall_idtaxa,
          perc_gen_fn_recall_idtaxa=fn_perc_gen_idtaxa,  
          # Precision (genus q2)
          precision_gen_q2_dataset=precision_gen_q2_dataset,
          precision_gen_q2=precision_gen_q2,
          perc_gen_tp_precision_q2=perc_tp_precision_q2,
          perc_gen_fp_precision_q2=perc_fp_q2,
          # perc_gen_unassigned_precision_q2=unassigned_q2,
          # precision (genus idtaxa)
          precision_gen_idtaxa_dataset=precision_gen_q2_dataset,
          precision_gen_idtaxa=precision_gen_idtaxa,
          perc_gen_tp_precision_idtaxa=perc_tp_precision_idtaxa,
          perc_gen_fp_precision_idtaxa=perc_fp_idtaxa,
          # perc_gen_unassigned_precision_idtaxa=unassigned_idtaxa
    ) # %>% arrange(tolower(pipeline))

    
  # Define groupings, variables, classifiers
  groupings <- c("asv", "gen")
  variables <- c("recall", "precision")

  gt_tbl <- gt(s_full) %>%
    tab_header(title = md(paste0("**Recall and precision for dataset ", d, "**")))

  # First: level 3 spanners: classifiers
  for (gr in groupings) {
    
    classify <- if (gr == "asv") "none" else classifiers  
    
    for (var in variables) {
      for (cl in classify) {
        
        # Find columns matching variable, grouping, and classifier
        cols_for_var <- colnames(s_full)[
          grepl(var, colnames(s_full)) &
          grepl(gr, colnames(s_full))
        ]

        if (!cl %in% "none") cols_for_var <- cols_for_var[grepl(cl, cols_for_var)]
        
        if (length(cols_for_var) == 0) next

        if (any(grepl("perc", cols_for_var))) {
          perc_vars <- cols_for_var[grepl("perc", cols_for_var)]
          gt_tbl <- gt_tbl %>%
            fmt_percent(
              columns = all_of(perc_vars),
              decimals = 2,
              scale_values = FALSE)
        }
        
        # Pretty label for classifier
        pretty_lab_c <- case_when(
          cl == "none" ~ " ",
          cl == "q2" ~ "q2-nb",
          cl == "idtaxa" ~ "IDTAXA",
          TRUE ~ cl)

        spanner_id <- paste0("classifier_", gr, "_", var, "_", cl)
        print(paste(spanner_id))
        
        gt_tbl <- gt_tbl %>%
          tab_spanner(label = pretty_lab_c, columns = all_of(cols_for_var), id = spanner_id)
      }
    }
  }

  # Second: level 2 spanners: precision / recall spanning their classifiers
  for (gr in groupings) {
    for (var in variables) {
      
      # Get all columns for this group and var (any classifier)
      cols_for_var <- colnames(s_full)[
        grepl(var, colnames(s_full)) &
        grepl(gr, colnames(s_full))
      ]
      
      if (length(cols_for_var) == 0) next

      pretty_lab_var <- case_when(
          var == "recall" ~ "Recall (TP / expected)",
          var == "precision" ~ "Precision (TP / observed)",
          TRUE ~ var)

      spanner_id <- paste0("classifier_", gr, "_", var)
      print(paste(spanner_id))
      
      gt_tbl <- gt_tbl %>%
        tab_spanner(label = pretty_lab_var, columns = all_of(cols_for_var), id = spanner_id)
    }
  }

  # Third: level 1 spanners: ASV / genus spanning all precision & recall columns
  for (gr in groupings) {
    
    cols_for_group <- colnames(s_full)[
      grepl(gr, colnames(s_full))
    ]
    
    if (length(cols_for_group) == 0) next

    pretty_lab_group <- case_when(
          gr == "asv" ~ "ASV-level",
          gr == "gen" ~ "Genus-level",
          TRUE ~ gr)
    
    spanner_id <- paste0("classifier_", gr)
    print(paste(spanner_id))
    
    gt_tbl <- gt_tbl %>%
      tab_spanner(label = pretty_lab_group, columns = all_of(cols_for_group), id = spanner_id)

    col_label_map <- c(
      recall_asv_dataset = "Recall (across dataset)",
      recall_asv = "Recall (count)",
      recall_asv_1mm = "Recall (count, 1 mismatch)",
      perc_asv_tp_recall = "% TP reads",
      perc_asv_fn_recall = "% FN  reads",
      precision_asv_dataset = "Precision (across dataset)",
      precision_asv = "Precision (count)",
      precision_asv_1mm = "Precision (count, 1 mismatch)",
      perc_asv_tp_precision = "% TP reads",
      perc_asv_1mm_precision = "% 1 mismatch",
      perc_asv_fp_precision = "% FP reads",
      recall_gen_q2_dataset = "Recall (across dataset)",
      recall_gen_q2 = "Recall (count)",
      perc_gen_tp_recall_q2 = "% TP reads",
      perc_gen_fn_recall_q2 = "% FN reads",
      recall_gen_idtaxa_dataset = "Recall (across dataset)",
      recall_gen_idtaxa = "Recall (count)",
      perc_gen_tp_recall_idtaxa = "% TP genera",
      perc_gen_fn_recall_idtaxa = "% FN reads",
      precision_gen_q2_dataset = "Precision (across dataset)",
      precision_gen_q2 = "Precision (count)",
      perc_gen_tp_precision_q2 = "% TP reads",
      perc_gen_fp_precision_q2 = "% FP reads",
      precision_gen_idtaxa_dataset = "Precision (across dataset)",
      precision_gen_idtaxa = "Precision (count)",
      perc_gen_tp_precision_idtaxa = "% TP reads",
      perc_gen_fp_precision_idtaxa = "% FP reads"
      # add all columns you want to rename here
    )

    gt_tbl <- gt_tbl %>%
      cols_label(.list = col_label_map)

  }

  gtsave(gt_tbl, paste0(plot_path, "STable_recall", d, ".docx"))

}
```

```{r seq_depth_plt, eval=FALSE}

stats_sample <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "stats_sample_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus_picrustrecall.rds"))
pltlist <- list()
df_comb <- list()

for (d in datasets$datasets) {
  df <- stats_sample[[d]][[3]]
  df_comb[[d]] <- data.frame(pipeline = character(), reads_out=numeric())

  for (p in pipelines) {
    if (is.null(stats_sample[[d]][[p]])) next
    df2 <- stats_sample[[d]][[p]] %>% select(reads_out) %>% mutate(pipeline = p)

    df_comb[[d]] <- df_comb[[d]] %>%
      add_row(df2 %>% select(reads_out) %>% mutate(pipeline = p)) 
  
  }

  df_comb[[d]] <- df_comb[[d]] %>% 
    bind_rows(data.frame(pipeline = "Input", reads_out=df$reads_in)) %>%
    mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = c("Input", pipelines)))

  pltlist[["reads_out"]][[d]] <- ggplot(data = df_comb[[d]], aes(x = pipeline, y = reads_out, fill=pipeline, color = pipeline)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Input" = "black", cols_p)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Input" = "black", cols_p)) +
    my_theme(theme_classic) +
    labs(title = titles_d[[d]], y = "# reads") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          panel.grid.major.x=element_line(color = "#EAEAEA", linewidth = 0.1),
          plot.title=element_text(hjust=0.5))

}

combined <- wrap_plots(pltlist$reads_out, ncol=4, nrow=2) +
            plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
                    theme(legend.position = "none",

ggsave(paste0(plot_path, "SFigure_reads.pdf"),
```

```{r suppl_fig_descstat, eval=FALSE} 
stats_sample <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "stats_sample_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus_picrustrecall.rds"))
stats_dataset <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "stats_dataset_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus_perctpfp_picrustrecall.rds"))
```

### Running statistics per dataset
Sparsity, % reads lost, output read length

```{r other_stats2, eval=FALSE}

stats_sample <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "stats_sample_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus_picrustrecall.rds"))
stats_dataset <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "stats_dataset_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus_perctpfp_picrustrecall.rds"))
rl <- read_tsv(read_length_all, col_names=TRUE) # Read lengths for plotting

pltlist <- list()

for (d in datasets$datasets) {

  df_sample <- lapply(names(stats_sample[[d]]), function(p) {
      stats_sample[[d]][[p]] %>% select(sample_names, reads_lost) %>%
                                 mutate(pipeline = p)
  }) %>% bind_rows() %>% 
  mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = pipelines))

  plt <- df_sample %>%
    ggplot(., aes(x = pipeline, y = reads_lost, fill = pipeline, color = pipeline)) 

  if (!d %in% mocks) {
    plt <- plt + 
      # geom_violin(alpha = 0.5, width = 2.2) +
      geom_boxplot(linewidth=0.2, outlier.size=0.1, alpha = 0.7) + #+ color = "black"
      guides(color = "none", fill = "none")
      # geom_jitter(shape = 21, size = 0.02, width = 0.05, alpha = 0.3)
  } else {
    plt <- plt + 
      geom_point(shape = 21, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7) 
  }

  pltlist[["readslost"]][[d]] <- plt + 
    scale_fill_manual(values = cols_p) +   
    scale_color_manual(values = cols_p) +  
    my_theme(theme_classic) + 
    theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "lightgrey", linewidth=0.05),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          legend.position = "none",
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
    labs(y = "",
         x = "",
         title = titles_d[d]) +
    ylim(c(0, 100))

  # Sparsity
  if(!d %in% reals) {
    tse_exp <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_exp_", d, ".rds"))

    df_dataset <- stats_dataset[[d]] %>%
      select(pipeline, sparsity) %>%
      add_row(pipeline = "Expected", sparsity = sum(assay(tse_exp) == 0) / (nrow(tse_exp)*ncol(tse_exp)) * 100) %>%
      mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = c(pipelines)))
  } else {
    df_dataset <- stats_dataset[[d]] %>%
      select(pipeline, sparsity) %>%
      mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = pipelines))
  }
  
  pltlist[["sparsity"]][[d]] <- ggplot(df_dataset, aes(x = pipeline, y = sparsity, fill = ifelse(pipeline == "Expected", "Expected", "Pipeline"))) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    scale_fill_manual(
        values = c("Expected" = "#A6A6A6",
                  "Pipeline" = "#D3D3D3"),
        breaks = c("Expected", "Pipeline")) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = df_dataset$sparsity[df_dataset$pipeline == "Expected"], linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
    guides(color = "none", fill = "none") +
    my_theme(theme_classic) + 
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    labs(y = "",
         x = "") +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "lightgrey", linewidth=0.05)) +
    ylim(c(0, 100))

  # Output read length
  pltlist[["readlength"]][[d]] <- rl %>% 
    filter(Dataset %in% d) %>%
    group_by(Pipeline) %>%
    slice_sample(n = 700) %>%
    ungroup() %>%  
    mutate(Pipeline = factor(Pipeline, levels = pipelines)) %>% 
    ggplot(., aes(x = Pipeline, y = Length, fill = Pipeline, color = Pipeline)) +
      # geom_violin(alpha = 0.5, width = 1.5) +
      geom_jitter(shape = 21, size = 0.05, width = 0.3, alpha = 0.3) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = cols_p) +
      scale_color_manual(values = cols_p) + 
      my_theme(theme_classic) + 
      theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "lightgrey", linewidth=0.05),
            axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
            legend.position = "none") +
      guides(color = "none", fill = "none") +
      labs(y = "", x = "") +
      scale_y_continuous(
        limits = c(65, 500)) 
}

plt <- wrap_plots(pltlist[["readslost"]], ncol = 7) / 
       wrap_plots(pltlist[["sparsity"]], ncol = 7) /
       wrap_plots(pltlist[["readlength"]], ncol = 7) +
                  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
                  theme(legend.position = "none",
                  legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
                  legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
                  legend.key.width = unit(0.5, "cm"),
                  legend.key.height = unit(0.5, "cm"))

# Convert to grob and add labels

## Assess correlations between these measures across datasets (perform consistently?)
cor_df <- data.frame(dataset = character(),
                      pipeline = character(),
                      reads_lost = numeric(),
                      sparsity = numeric(),
                      mean_readlength = numeric(),
                      median_readlength = numeric(),
                      sd_readlength = numeric())

for (d in datasets$datasets) {
  df_sample <- lapply(names(stats_sample[[d]]), function(p) {
      stats_sample[[d]][[p]] %>% select(sample_names, reads_lost) %>%
                                 mutate(pipeline = p)
  }) %>% bind_rows()

  df_dataset <- stats_dataset[[d]] %>%
      select(pipeline, sparsity) 

  rl_sub <- rl %>%
    filter(Dataset %in% d) %>%
    group_by(Pipeline) %>%
    summarize(mean_readlength = mean(Length, na.rm = TRUE),
              median_readlength = median(Length, na.rm = TRUE),
              sd_readlength = sd(Length, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    ungroup() 

  for (p in pipelines) {
    cor_df <- cor_df %>%
      add_row(dataset = d,
              pipeline = p,
              reads_lost = mean(df_sample$reads_lost[df_sample$pipeline == p], na.rm = TRUE),
              sparsity = df_dataset$sparsity[df_dataset$pipeline == p],
              mean_readlength = rl_sub$mean_readlength[rl_sub$Pipeline == p],
              median_readlength = rl_sub$median_readlength[rl_sub$Pipeline == p],
              sd_readlength = rl_sub$sd_readlength[rl_sub$Pipeline == p])
  }
}

cor_df_wide <- cor_df %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = dataset, values_from = c(reads_lost, sparsity, mean_readlength, median_readlength, sd_readlength)) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "pipeline")

pltlist <- list()

titles <- c("reads_lost" = "% Reads lost", 
            "sparsity" = "Sparsity (% zeros)", 
            "mean_readlength" = "Mean read length (bp)",

for (sub in c("reads_lost", "sparsity", "mean_readlength", "median_readlength", "sd_readlength")) {

  t <- titles[names(titles) %in% sub]

   df_cor <- cor_df_wide %>% 
    select(contains(sub)) %>%
    rename_with(~ gsub(paste0(sub, "_"), "", .x), everything()) %>%
    cor(., use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "spearman")

  pltlist[[sub]] <- ggcorrplot(df_cor, 
            method = "square", 
            type = "lower",
            lab = FALSE,
            lab_size = 3) +

      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),  
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      axis.line = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.line.x = element_line(colour = "black"),
      axis.line.y = element_line(colour = "black"),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
}

plt <- wrap_plots(pltlist, ncol = 5) +
```

### Abundance Plot 
```{r ave_ab_plt, eval=FALSE}

plt_df <- readRDS(paste0(output_path, "abundance_distributions.rds"))

pltlist <- list()
pltlist_tp <- list()

titles <- c("asv" = "ASV",
            "q2" = "q2 (genus)",
            "idtaxa" = "IDTAXA (genus)",
            "def" = "Default (genus)",
            "KO" = "Kegg Orthologs (picrust)",
            "cyc" = "MetaCyc Pathways (picrust)")
i <- 0

for (d in datasets$datasets) {
  
  min_d <- 1e-09
  max_d <- 1

  xlim_d <- c(min_d, max_d) # for plotting 

  i <- i + 1

  for (tr in c("asv", "def", "q2", "idtaxa", "KO", "cyc")) {

    noexp <- (d %in% reals) || tr %in% c("def", "KO", "cyc") # no expected abundance info available
    t <- ifelse(i == 1, titles[names(titles) %in% tr], "") # only plot titles for first row of plots 
    x <- ifelse(i == length(datasets$datasets), "log10(relabundance)", "")

    #### Plotting
    # Abundance density plot
    pltlist[[d]][[tr]] <- plt_df[[d]][[tr]] %>%
      mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = rev(pipelines))) %>%
      ggplot(., aes(x=ab+1E-20, y = pipeline, color = pipeline, fill = pipeline)) +
        geom_density_ridges(alpha = 0.5) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = cols_p) +
        scale_color_manual(values = cols_p) +
        my_theme(theme_classic) +
        scale_x_log10(limits=xlim_d) +
        labs(title = t, y="", x = x) +
          theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1),
                plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

    # Abundance density plot (TP vs FP)
    if (!noexp) {

      min_n <- 5
      x <- ifelse(i == length(mocks)+length(sims), "log10(relabundance)", "")
      
      pltlist_tp[[d]][[tr]] <- plt_df[[d]][[tr]] %>% 
        mutate(tp = factor(ifelse(tp %in% "TP", "TP", "FP"))) %>%
        mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = rev(pipelines))) %>%
        group_by(pipeline, tp) %>%
        mutate(n_per_group = n(),
               plot_type = ifelse(n_per_group >= min_n, "density", "points")) %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        ggplot(., aes(x=ab+1E-20, y = pipeline, color = pipeline, fill = pipeline)) +
          geom_density_ridges(alpha = 0.3,
                      scale = 1, rel_min_height = 0.01) +
          geom_point(data = ~subset(.x, plot_type == "points"),
                     size = 0.8, alpha = 0.6) +
          scale_fill_manual(values = cols_p, drop=FALSE) +
          scale_color_manual(values = cols_p, drop=FALSE) +
          my_theme(theme_bw) +
          scale_x_log10(x, limits=xlim_d) +
          labs(y = "", title = t) +
          facet_wrap(~tp) +
          theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1),
                plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
    }
  }
}
```

### False negative abundances
```{r ab_fn, eval=FALSE}

fps <- readRDS(paste0(output_path, "abundance_distributions.rds"))
fns <- readRDS(paste0(output_path, "abundance_distributions_fn.rds"))

combined <- list()
tit_lev <- c("asv" = "ASV-level", "q2" = "Genus-level (q2)", "idtaxa" = "Genus-level (IDTAXA)")

for (lev in c("asv", "q2", "idtaxa")) {

  # False negatives 
  df_fn <- fns[[lev]] %>%
    mutate(tp = factor(tp, levels = c("tp", "fn"), labels = c("True Positive", "False Negative"))) %>%
    filter(dataset %in% sims) %>% 
    mutate(dataset = factor(dataset, levels = datasets$datasets, labels = titles_d))  

  # False positives
  df_fp <- lapply(c(mocks, sims), function(d) {
    fps[[d]][[lev]] %>%
      mutate(dataset = d)
  }) %>% bind_rows() %>% 
    mutate(tp = factor(ifelse(tp %in% "TP", "tp", "fp"), levels = c("tp", "fp"), labels = c("True Positive", "False Positive"))) %>%
    filter(dataset %in% sims) %>% 
    mutate(dataset = factor(dataset, levels = datasets$datasets, labels = titles_d))  

  # Plot
  tit <- c("ab" = "Abundance", "prev" = "Prevalence")
  pltlist <- list()

  for (o in c("df_fn", "df_fp")) {
    df <- get(o)

    pltlist[[o]] <- lapply(c("ab", "prev"), function(var) { 
      df %>% 
        ggplot(., aes(x = tp, y = .data[[var]])) +
          geom_violin() +
          stat_summary(aes(fill = pipeline, color = pipeline), fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 1, position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) +
          # geom_point(aes(fill = pipeline, color = pipeline)) +
          facet_wrap(~dataset, ncol=4) +
          scale_y_log10() +
          my_theme(theme_bw) +
          labs(x = "", y = paste("Log",tit[[var]]), title = tit[[var]]) +
          theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1),
                plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5)) +
          guides(fill = "none", color="none")
    })
  }

  comb <- wrap_plots(pltlist[["df_fn"]], ncol = 2) /
          wrap_plots(pltlist[["df_fp"]], ncol = 2) 

  pdf(NULL)
  comb <- patchworkGrob(comb)
  dev.off()

  combined[[lev]] <- arrangeGrob(comb, 
            left = textGrob(rev(c("False Negative", "False Positive")), 
                    rot = 0, 
                    gp = gpar(fontsize = 8, fontface = "bold", fontfamily = "Montserrat"),
```

```{r feat_pipeline, eval=FALSE}
# ASVs/Genus in mocks + sims 
for (d in c(mocks, sims)) {

  gen_fn <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "genus_fn_tp_", d, ".rds"))

  for (c in classifiers) {

    tse_exp <- readRDS(paste0(output_path, "tse_exp_fn_tp_", d, ".rds"))
    count_fn <- sapply(pipelines, function(x) {
      status_col <- paste0("fn_", x)
      if (!status_col %in% colnames(rowData(tse_exp))) return(NA)
      sum(rowData(tse_exp)[[status_col]] == "fn", na.rm = TRUE)
    }) %>% data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column(var = "pipeline")

    colnames(count_fn) <- c("pipeline", "fn_count") 

    df_tmp <- stats_dataset[[d]] %>%
      select(pipeline, asv, asv_tp, asv_1mm, asv_silva0, num_genus = !!paste0("num_genus_", c), genus_tp = !!paste0("genus_tp_", c)) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(count_fn, by = "pipeline")

    df_tmp2 <- stats_dataset[[d]] %>% select(pipeline, perc_tp_precision, perc_1mm_precision, perc_fp)

    gen_fn_sub <- gen_fn[[d]][[c]]
    count_fn <- sapply(pipelines, function(x) {
      status_col <- paste0("fn_", x)
      if (!status_col %in% colnames(gen_fn_sub)) return(NA)
      sum(gen_fn_sub[[status_col]] == "fn", na.rm = TRUE)
    }) %>% data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column(var = "pipeline")

    colnames(count_fn) <- c("pipeline", "fn_count_genus")

    pltlist[[c]][[d]]  <- ggplot(df_tmp) +
```

```{r deviate, echo=FALSE}
stats_sample <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "stats_sample_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus_picrustrecall.rds"))
stats_dataset <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "stats_dataset_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus_perctpfp_picrustrecall_mds_perm_cor_alpha2_beta_da2_z.rds"))

# PLot deviation from average # asv per pipeline (%) 
tit <- c("asv" = "ASV", "num_genus" = "Genus (default)", "num_genus_q2" = "Genus (q2)", "num_genus_idtaxa" = "Genus (idtaxa)")
pltlist <- list()

for (var in c("asv", "num_genus","num_genus_q2", "num_genus_idtaxa")) {
  df_tmp <- lapply(datasets$datasets, function(d) {
    stats_dataset[[d]] %>%
          select(pipeline, var=all_of(var)) %>%
          mutate(dataset = d)
  }) %>% bind_rows()

  df_avg <- df_tmp %>% 
    group_by(dataset) %>% 
    summarize(avg = mean(var, na.rm=TRUE))

  df_tmp2 <- df_tmp %>% 
    dplyr::left_join(., df_avg, by = "dataset") %>% 
    mutate(perc_diff = (var - avg) / avg)

  pltlist[[var]] <- df_tmp2 %>% 
    filter(!pipeline %in% c("LotuS2_otu")) %>% 
    mutate(dataset = factor(dataset, levels = datasets$datasets),
          pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = pipelines)) %>%
    ggplot(., aes(x = pipeline, y = perc_diff)) +
      stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "bar", position = position_dodge(width = 0.1)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
      geom_point(aes(color=dataset, fill=dataset), size=1, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
      my_theme(theme_classic) +
      scale_color_manual(values = cols_d) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = cols_d) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
            panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "lightgrey", linewidth=0.05),
            plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5)) +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
      labs(x = "", y = "% difference from pipeline average", title=paste0(tit[[var]])) +
      guides(fill = "none", color= "none")
}

combined <- wrap_plots(pltlist, ncol = 4) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect")

  df <- stats_dataset[[d]] %>% select(pipeline, 
                                      recall=recallrate, recall_perc=tp_perc_recall, 
                                      precision=precisionrate, precision_perc=perc_tp_precision)

      summarize_all(mean) %>%

  df <- df %>%

    mutate(dataset = d)
}) %>% bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(recall_perc = recall_perc/100,
         precision_perc = precision_perc/100) %>% 
  pivot_longer(-c(pipeline, dataset), names_to="var", values_to="value")
```

```{r plot_asv_gen_sample, eval=FALSE}
stats_sample <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "stats_sample_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus_picrustrecall.rds"))
pltlist_recall <- list()

make_plots <- function(df, suffix, title) {

      lapply(c("recall", "precision"), function(v) {
        plt <- df %>% 
          select(pipeline, sample_names, !!paste0(v, suffix)) %>%
          ggplot(aes(x = pipeline, y = .data[[paste0(v, suffix)]], fill = pipeline, color = pipeline))  
        
        if (length(unique(df$sample_names)) < 5) {
          plt <- plt + 
            geom_point(shape = 21, size = 2, alpha = 0.5)
        } else {
          plt <- plt + 
            geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.1)
        }
        
        plt <- plt + 
            scale_fill_manual(values = cols_p) +
            scale_color_manual(values = cols_p) +
            my_theme(theme_classic) +
            theme(
              axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "bar", position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +              legend.position = "none",
              plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5)) +
            labs(y = "", title = title, x = "") +
            ylim(c(0, 1))
      })
    }

for (d in datasets$datasets) {
  df_sample <- lapply(names(stats_sample[[d]]), function(p) {
      s_list <- c("sample_names", "asv", "num_genus_q2", "num_genus_idtaxa")
      if("num_genus" %in% colnames(stats_sample[[d]][[p]])) s_list <- c(s_list, "num_genus") # For APSCALE
      stats_sample[[d]][[p]] %>% select(all_of(s_list)) %>%
                                 mutate(pipeline = p)
    }) %>% bind_rows() %>%
    mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = pipelines))
    
    # Total ASVs
  for (v in c("asv", "num_genus", "num_genus_q2", "num_genus_idtaxa")) {
    if (length(unique(df_sample$sample_names)) < 5) {
      pltlist_recall[[v]][[d]] <- ggplot(data = df_sample, aes(x = pipeline, y = .data[[v]], fill = pipeline, color = pipeline)) +
        geom_point(shape = 21, size = 2, alpha=0.5) +
        my_theme(theme_classic) +
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
    } else {
      pltlist_recall[[v]][[d]] <- ggplot(data = df_sample, aes(x = pipeline, y = .data[[v]], fill = pipeline, color = pipeline)) +
        geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.5) 
    }

    t <- ifelse(v %in% "asv", titles_d[d], "")

    pltlist_recall[[v]][[d]] <- pltlist_recall[[v]][[d]] +
      scale_fill_manual(values = cols_p) +
      scale_color_manual(values = cols_p) +
      my_theme(theme_classic) +
      labs(title = t, x = "", y = "") +

            legend.position = "none",
            panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "lightgrey", linewidth=0.05),
            plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5))
  }

  if (d %in% reals) next

  # Recall precision scatter (asv)
  df_sample <- lapply(names(stats_sample[[d]]), function(p) {
      stats_sample[[d]][[p]] %>% select(sample_names, recallrate, recallrate_1mm,
                                        precisionrate, precisionrate_1mm) %>%
                                mutate(pipeline = p)
    }) %>% bind_rows() %>%
    mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = pipelines))

  # Recall perfect match (0mm)
  pltlist_recall[["pr_scatter_asv"]][[d]] <- df_sample %>% 
      slice_sample(prop=1) %>% 
      ggplot(aes(x = recallrate, y = precisionrate, fill = pipeline, color = pipeline)) +
        # stat_ellipse(alpha = 1, linewidth = 1, type = "t") +
        geom_point(shape = 21, alpha = 0.7) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = cols_p, drop=FALSE) +

        ylim(c(0, 1)) +
        theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5)) +
        guides(fill = "none", color = "none") +
        theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "lightgrey", linewidth=0.05),
              panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "lightgrey", linewidth=0.05))        

  # recall 1mm (1mm)
  pltlist_recall[["pr_scatter_1mm"]][[d]] <- df_sample %>% 
      ggplot(aes(x = recallrate, y = precisionrate, fill = pipeline, color = pipeline)) +
        geom_segment(aes(x = recallrate, y = precisionrate, 
                        xend = recallrate_1mm, yend = precisionrate_1mm, 
                        group = sample_names, color = pipeline), alpha = 0.5) +
        geom_point(shape = 21, alpha = 0.7) +
        geom_point(aes(x = recallrate_1mm, y = precisionrate_1mm,fill = pipeline, color = pipeline), shape = 21, alpha = 0.7) +

  for (c in classifiers) {

    # genus
    lstmp <- make_plots(df=df_sample, suffix="_gen", title=c)
    pltlist_recall[["recall_gen"]][[c]][[d]]    <- lstmp[[1]] + ggtitle("")
    pltlist_recall[["precision_gen"]][[c]][[d]] <- lstmp[[2]] + ggtitle("")

    # asv
    lstmp <- make_plots(df=df_sample, suffix="rate", title=titles_d[d])
    pltlist_recall[["recall_asv"]][[d]] <- lstmp[[1]]
    pltlist_recall[["precision_asv"]][[d]] <- lstmp[[2]] + ggtitle("")

    # Scatter genus level
    pltlist_recall[["pr_scatter_gen"]][[c]][[d]] <- df_sample %>% 
        slice_sample(prop=1) %>% # to make point appear in random order (to see all)
        ggplot(., aes(x = recall_gen, y = precision_gen, fill = pipeline, color = pipeline)) +
          geom_point(shape = 21, alpha = 0.7, position = position_jitter(width = 0.003, height = 0.003)) +

          theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "lightgrey", linewidth=0.05),
                panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "lightgrey", linewidth=0.05))

  }
}

  }) %>% bind_rows()

    ggcorrplot(., 
            method = "square", 
            type = "lower",
            lab = FALSE,

      axis.line.x = element_line(colour = "black"),
      axis.line.y = element_line(colour = "black"),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
  })

  pltlist[["mean"]][[v]] <- plttmp[[1]]
  pltlist[["sd"]][[v]]   <- plttmp[[2]]

}
```

### False and True Positives per pipeline
```{r plot_tp_fp, eval=FALSE}

FP_stats <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "FP_stats_pipelines_datasets.rds"))
TP_mat <- FP_stats$tp_mat
FPs <- FP_stats$FP
FNs <- FP_stats$FN

pltlist <- list()

for (d in c(mocks, sims)) {
  for (c in classifiers) {
    
    if (d %in% mocks) {
      ro <- pipelines[!pipelines %in% c("Expected")]# Not expected
      co <- sort(TP_mat[[d]][[c]]$genus)
    } else {
      ro <- pipelines[!pipelines %in% c("Expected", "eDNAFlow")]# Not expected, not eDNAFlow
      co <- TP_mat[[d]][[c]][-1] %>% rowSums(.)  # column order
      names(co) <- TP_mat[[d]][[c]]$genus
      co <- co %>% sort(decreasing = TRUE) %>% names()
    }

    presence_df <- as.data.frame(TP_mat[[d]][[c]]) %>%
      pivot_longer(-genus, names_to = "pipeline", values_to = "presence")

    presence_df$genus <- factor(presence_df$genus, levels = co)
    presence_df$pipeline <- factor(presence_df$pipeline, levels = ro)

    pltlist[["TP_mat"]][[c]][[d]] <- ggplot(presence_df, aes(x = pipeline, y = genus, fill = factor(presence))) +
    geom_tile(color = "transparent", alpha = 1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("white", "#A9D08E"), labels = c("Absent", "Present")) +
    scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    my_theme(theme_bw) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(title = "Presence")) +
    labs(title = titles_d[d], x = "", y = "") +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

    if (d %in% sims) {
      pltlist[["TP_mat"]][[c]][[d]]  <- pltlist[["TP_mat"]][[c]][[d]]  + theme(axis.text.y = element_blank())
    }

    if (c %in% "idtaxa") {
      pltlist[["TP_mat"]][[c]][[d]] <- pltlist[["TP_mat"]][[c]][[d]] + ggtitle("")
    }

    # Plot FPs across pipelines
    fp_count <- FPs %>% filter(dataset == d, classifier == c) %>% group_by(genus) %>% summarize(n = n())
    ord <- fp_count %>% arrange(desc(n)) %>% pull(genus)
    fp_count$genus <- factor(fp_count$genus, levels = ord)

    pltlist[["FP_count"]][[c]][[d]] <- ggplot(fp_count, aes(x = genus, y = n)) +
      geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "#B1D3DE") +
      # geom_text(aes(label = n), vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
      labs(title = "", x = "Genus", y = "Count") +
      my_theme(theme_classic) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
            panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "lightgrey", linewidth=0.05)) +
      scale_y_continuous(breaks = function(x) unique(floor(pretty(seq(min(x), (max(x) + 1) * 1.1)))))

    pltlist[["FP_mat"]][[c]][[d]] <- FPs %>%
      filter(dataset == d, classifier == c) %>%
      mutate(presence = TRUE) %>%
      mutate(genus = factor(genus, levels = fp_count %>% arrange(desc(n)) %>% pull(genus))) %>%
      mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = ro)) %>%
      ggplot(., aes(x = pipeline, y = genus, fill = presence)) +
      geom_tile(color = "transparent", alpha = 1) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("#D39895", "white"), labels = c("False Positive", "Absent")) +
      scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
      my_theme(theme_bw) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
      labs(title = titles_d[d], x = "", y = "") +
      guides(fill = guide_legend(title = "False Positive")) +
      theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
            panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
            panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
            plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

    if (c %in% "idtaxa") {
      pltlist[["FP_mat"]][[c]][[d]] <- pltlist[["FP_mat"]][[c]][[d]] + ggtitle("")
    }
  
    fn_count <- FNs %>% filter(dataset == d, classifier == c) %>% group_by(genus) %>% summarize(n = n())
    ord <- fn_count %>% arrange(desc(n)) %>% pull(genus)
    fn_count$genus <- factor(fn_count$genus, levels = ord)

     pltlist[["FN_mat"]][[c]][[d]] <- FNs %>%
      filter(dataset == d, classifier == c) %>%
      mutate(presence = TRUE) %>%
      mutate(genus = factor(genus, levels = fn_count %>% arrange(desc(n)) %>% pull(genus))) %>%
      mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = ro)) %>%
      ggplot(., aes(x = pipeline, y = genus, fill = presence)) +
      geom_tile(color = "transparent", alpha = 1) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("#adadad55", "white"), labels = c("False Negative", "Absent")) +
      scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
      my_theme(theme_bw) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
      labs(title = titles_d[d], x = "", y = "") +
      guides(fill = guide_legend(title = "False Negative")) +
      theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
            panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
            panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
            plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))


    if (d %in% sims) {
      pltlist[["FN_mat"]][[c]][[d]]  <- pltlist[["FN_mat"]][[c]][[d]]  + theme(axis.text.y = element_blank())
    }

    if (c %in% "idtaxa") {
      pltlist[["FN_mat"]][[c]][[d]] <- pltlist[["FN_mat"]][[c]][[d]] + ggtitle("")
    }

  }
}
```

### Pairwise distance and Multi-Dimensional Scaling 
Note: compute all distances prior  
Get min an max distance values for uniform plotting 
```{r mds_minmax, eval=FALSE}

minmax <- data.frame(dataset = character(),
           level = character(),
           min = numeric(),
           max = numeric())

for (d in datasets$datasets) {
  for (c in c("asv", "asv199", "asv249", classifiers, "KO", "cyc")) {
    mydist <- "aitchison"
    lev <- ifelse(grepl("asv", c), "asv", "genus")
    trim <- ifelse(c %in% c("asv199", "asv249"), str_remove(c, "asv"), "")
    if (c %in% c("KO", "cyc")) lev <- "picrust"
    
    fname <- paste0(output_path, 
                  "dist_mds_", 
                  ifelse(!lev %in% c("asv", "picrust"), paste0(c, "_"), ""), 
                  mydist, "_", d, "_", lev, trim, ".rds")
    
    if (lev %in% "picrust") {
      fname <- gsub("mds_", "mds__", fname)
      fname <- gsub(paste0(lev, ".rds"), paste0(c, ".rds"), fname)
    }

    # if (!file.exists(fname)) next
    m_save <- readRDS(file = fname)

    minval <- m_save$m %>% select(-sample) %>% min(., na.rm=TRUE)
    maxval <- m_save$m %>% select(-sample) %>% max(., na.rm=TRUE)

    minmax <- minmax %>%
      add_row(dataset = d,
              level = c,
              min = minval,
              max = maxval)
  }
}

minmax <- minmax %>%
  mutate(min = floor(min - min*0.05),
         max = ceiling(max + max*0.05))

saveRDS(minmax, file = paste0(output_path, "mds_minmax.rds"))

```

```{r mds_mock5, eval=FALSE}
pltlist <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "mds_distance_plots.rds"))
minmax <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "mds_minmax.rds"))

# Genus 
for (c in classifiers) {
  tse <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_", c, "_mock5_genus_exp_allpipelines.rds"))
  tse <- transformAssay(tse, assay.type = "relabundance", method = "clr", pseudocount = TRUE)

  colData(tse)$sample2 <- ifelse(colData(tse)$pipeline %in% "Expected", paste0("Expected_", colData(tse)$sample), colData(tse)$sample)
  colData(tse)$evenstag <- ifelse(colData(tse)$sample %in% c("Even1", "Even2"), "Even", "Staggered")

  tse <- tse[, !tse$sample2 %in% c("Expected_Even2", "Expected_Staggered2")]
  meta <- data.frame(colData(tse))

  # Get distances
  for (mydist in c("aitchison", "jaccard")) {
    
    if(mydist %in% c("jaccard")) {
      xminmax <- c(0,1)
    } else {
       xminmax <- minmax %>% filter(level %in% c) %>% select(min, max)
       xminmax <- c(min(xminmax), max(xminmax))
    }

    print("Get distances")

    if (mydist %in% "aitchison") {
      atype="clr"
      method="euclidean"
    } else {
      atype <- ifelse("counts" %in%  assayNames(tse), "counts", "relabundance")
      method="jaccard"
    }
    
    
    # Get distance to expected
    mat <- getDissimilarity(tse, method = method, assay.type = atype) %>% as.matrix()
    mat2 <- mat
    mat <- as.data.frame(mat) %>% dplyr::select(all_of(contains("Expected")))
    mat$dist <- ifelse(grepl("Even", rownames(mat)), mat$Expected_Even1, mat$Expected_Staggered1)
    mat <- mat %>% dplyr::select(-contains("Expected")) %>% rownames_to_column(var = "ID")

    # Average pair-wise distance to other pipeines plot
    pltlist[["exp"]][[mydist]][[c]][["distance"]][["mock5"]] <- data.frame(colData(tse)) %>% 
      dplyr::left_join(., mat, by = "ID") %>%
      filter(!pipeline %in% "Expected") %>%
      mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = pipelines)) %>%
      ggplot(., aes(x = pipeline, y = dist, color = pipeline)) +
        geom_point(size = 2, aes(shape = evenstag), alpha = 0.8) +
        geom_line(aes(group = pipeline)) +
        my_theme(theme_classic) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = cols_p) +
        scale_color_manual(values = cols_p) +
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
        theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "#EAEAEA", linewidth = 0.1)) +
        labs(x = "") +
        ylim(xminmax)

    # Run MDS on distance matrix
    mat <- mat2
    mat <- as.dist(mat)
    mds_res <- cmdscale(mat, eig = TRUE) 
    eig_vec <- mds_res$points %>% data.frame()
    colnames(eig_vec) <- c("PC1", "PC2")

    eig_vec <- eig_vec %>%
      rownames_to_column(var = "ID") %>%
      dplyr::left_join(., meta, by = "ID") %>% 
      column_to_rownames(var = "ID")

    # Get eigen values
    eig_vals <- mds_res$eig
    positive_eig <- eig_vals[eig_vals > 0]

    # Variance explained
    varexp_1 <- positive_eig[1] / sum(positive_eig)
    var_exp2 <- positive_eig[2] / sum(positive_eig)

    meta_eig <- eig_vec %>%
      rownames_to_column(var = "ID")
    
    # Plot MDS with lines representing distance to the expected
    pairs <- data.frame(ID = meta_eig$ID) %>%
      filter(!grepl("Expected", ID)) %>%
      mutate(expected = ifelse(grepl("Even", ID), "Expected_Even1", "Expected_Staggered1"))

    segments <- pairs %>%
      dplyr::left_join(meta_eig, by = c("ID" = "ID")) %>%      
      dplyr::left_join(meta_eig %>% select(ID, PC1, PC2), by = c("expected" = "ID"), suffix = c("", "_exp"))  # get coordinates of expected points

    pltlist[["exp"]][[mydist]][[c]][["mds"]][["mock5"]] <- ggplot() +
      geom_segment(data = segments, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, xend = PC1_exp, yend = PC2_exp), color = "#BFBFBF", linewidth = 0.05) +
      geom_point(data = filter(meta_eig, !pipeline %in% "Expected"), aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = pipeline, shape = evenstag), size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
      geom_point(data = filter(meta_eig, pipeline %in% "Expected"), aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, shape = evenstag), size = 2, color = "black", alpha = 1) +
      my_theme(theme_classic) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = cols_p) +
      scale_color_manual(values = cols_p) +
      labs(x = paste0("MDS1 (", round(varexp_1*100, 2), "%)"),
          y = paste0("MDS2 (", round(var_exp2*100, 2), "%)"),
          title = "Mock 5") +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5))
  }
}

saveRDS(pltlist, file = paste0(output_path, "mds_distance_plots.rds"))
```

```{r mds_other, eval=FALSE}
plt_mds <- function(df, eig_vals, w=0, h=0, cols_p, title) {

  # Variance explained
  positive_eig <- eig_vals[eig_vals > 0]
  varexp_1 <- positive_eig[1] / sum(positive_eig)
  var_exp2 <- positive_eig[2] / sum(positive_eig)

  ggplot(df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = pipeline, alpha = alpha)) +
            geom_point(shape = 19, size = 1.5, position = position_jitter(width=w, height=h)) +
            labs(x = paste0("MDS1 (", round(varexp_1*100, 2), "%)"),
                y = paste0("MDS2 (", round(var_exp2*100, 2), "%)"),
                title = title) +
            scale_alpha_manual(values = c("Expected" = 0.8, "Observed" = 0.6), guide = "none") +
            my_theme(theme_classic) +
            scale_color_manual(values = cols_p) +
            theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5)) 
}
```

```{r plotmdspairwise, eval=FALSE}
}

      for (lev in level) {
      
        pip_dist_mat <- distlist[[mydist]][[lev]][[d]][[c]] %>% as.matrix()   
        rownames(pip_dist_mat) <- colnames(pip_dist_mat) <- gsub(paste0("_", d), "", rownames(pip_dist_mat))

          xminmax <- c(0,1)

          mymax <- max(pip_dist_mat) * 1.05
```

```{r plot_all_mds, eval=FALSE}
pltlist <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "mds_distance_plots.rds"))

make_grob <- function(mds_list, dist_list, distmat_list, ncol_val, title_str) {
  plt <- wrap_plots(mds_list, ncol = ncol_val) /
         wrap_plots(dist_list, ncol = ncol_val) /
         wrap_plots(distmat_list, ncol = ncol_val) +
           plot_layout(guides = "collect", axis_titles = "collect_x") &
           theme(legend.position = "none")

  pdf(NULL)
  g <- patchworkGrob(plt)
  dev.off()

  arrangeGrob(g,
    top  = textGrob(title_str,
                    gp = gpar(fontsize = 15, fontface = "bold", fontfamily = "Montserrat")),
    left = textGrob(rev(c("MDS", "Average distance", "Distance matrix")),
                    rot = 0,
                    gp = gpar(fontsize = 8, fontface = "bold", fontfamily = "Montserrat"),
                    y = seq(0.225, 0.85, length.out = 3),
                    just = "left",
                    x = 0.1))
}
```

#### Between-sample distance (PICRUSt2)
Picrust gives very low distances between pipelines / high convergence / correlation
Test whether picrust tends to output features common between samples (= less detail/specific) 
If so, the distance between samples should be not too different from output between pipelines 

```{r picrust_mds, eval=FALSE}

pairwise_sample <- function(pipe_i, pipe_j) {
  # Get indices for each pipeline (rows for i, columns for j)
  idx_i <- which(pipe_names == pipe_i)
  idx_j <- which(pipe_names == pipe_j)  # since symmetric
  
  dists <- mat[idx_i, idx_j] %>% as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column(var = "sample_i") %>%
    pivot_longer(-sample_i, names_to = "sample_j", values_to = "distance") %>%
    mutate(sample_i = gsub(paste0(pipe_i, "_"), "", sample_i),
          sample_j = gsub(paste0(pipe_j, "_"), "", sample_j)) %>%
    filter(sample_i == sample_j)   %>% # only keep matching sample pairs 
    mutate(pipeline_i = pipe_i, pipeline_j = pipe_j)

  return(dists)
}

for (mydist in c("jaccard", "aitchison")) {
  
  print(mydist)
  
  if (mydist %in% "jaccard") {
    dist <- "jaccard"
    methods <- "relabundance"
  } else {
    dist <- "euclidean"
    methods <- "clr"
  }


  d <- "gemsim"
  c <- "KO"

  # load dist mat
  m_save <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "dist_mds__", ,mydist, "_", d, "_", c, ".rds"))
  mat <- m_save$mat %>% as.matrix()

  samp_names <- gsub(paste(paste0(c("Expected", pipelines), "_"), collapse = "|"), "", rownames(mat))
  n_samp <- length(unique(samp_names))
  patterns <- paste0(c("Expected", pipelines), collapse = "|")  # "pipeline1|pipeline2|...|pipeline14"
  pipe_names <- gsub(paste0("^(.*(", patterns, "))(.*)$"), "\\1", rownames(mat))
  unique_pipelines <- unique(pipe_names)
  n_pipe <- length(unique(pipe_names))
      
  dist_df <- data.frame(sample_i = character(), 
                        sample_j = character(), 
                        distance = numeric(), 
                        pipeline_i = character(), 
                        pipeline_j = character())

  pcomb <- data.frame(i = character(), j = character())

  for (i in seq_along(unique_pipelines)) {
    for (j in seq_along(unique_pipelines)) {

      if (unique_pipelines[i] %in% c("LotuS2_otu","NGTax2") || unique_pipelines[j] %in% c("LotuS2_otu","NGTax2")) next # skip NGTax2 because of different read length (and thus different features)

      ij <- any(pcomb$i == unique_pipelines[i] & pcomb$j == unique_pipelines[j], na.rm=TRUE)
      ji <- any(pcomb$i == unique_pipelines[j] & pcomb$j == unique_pipelines[i], na.rm=TRUE)

      pcomb <- bind_rows(pcomb, data.frame(i = unique_pipelines[i], j = unique_pipelines[j]))

      print(paste("Processing pair:", unique_pipelines[i], "and", unique_pipelines[j]))
    
      tmp <- pairwise_sample(unique_pipelines[i], unique_pipelines[j])
      dist_df <- bind_rows(dist_df, tmp)

    }
  }

  dist_df$between_pipeline <- TRUE

  # MDS on one dataset to get distance matrix between samples
  tse <- readRDS(paste0(output_path, "tse_", c, "_", d, "picrust_list_allpipelines.rds"))

  for (p in names(tse)) {

    if (p %in% c("LotuS2_otu","NGTax2")) next
    print(p)
    
    tse_sub <- tse[[p]]
    if (!"relabundance" %in% assayNames(tse_sub)) tse_sub <- transformAssay(tse_sub, assay.type = "counts", method = "relabundance", pseudocount = FALSE)
    if (!"clr" %in% assayNames(tse_sub)) tse_sub <- transformAssay(tse_sub, assay.type = "relabundance", method = "clr", pseudocount = TRUE)

    mat2 <- getDissimilarity(tse_sub, method = dist, assay.type = methods) %>% as.matrix()

    tmp <- data.frame(mat2) %>% 
      rownames_to_column(var = "sample_i") %>%
      pivot_longer(-sample_i, names_to = "sample_j", values_to = "distance") %>%
      filter(sample_i != sample_j) %>%
      mutate(pipeline_i = p, pipeline_j = p, between_pipeline = FALSE)
    
    dist_df <- bind_rows(dist_df, tmp)
  }

  # dist_df$distance <- 1 - dist_df$distance # Convert to similarity 

  plt <- dist_df %>%
    mutate(between_pipeline = ifelse(between_pipeline == TRUE, "Between pipelines", "Between samples")) %>%
    ggplot(., aes(x = between_pipeline, y = distance, fill = between_pipeline, color = between_pipeline)) + 
      geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.size=0.8) + 
      my_theme(theme_classic) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("#5eb8e8ff", "#72bf6cff")) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("#5eb8e8ff", "#72bf6cff")) +
      labs(x = "", y = "Jaccard Similarity", ) +
      guides(fill = "none", color = "none") +
      # ylim(0, 1) +
      theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "#EAEAEA", linewidth = 0.1))

  plt1 <- dist_df %>% 
    filter(between_pipeline == TRUE) %>% 
    filter(pipeline_i != pipeline_j) %>% 
    mutate(pipeline_i = factor(pipeline_i, levels = pipelines, labels = pipelines_l)) %>% 
    ggplot(., aes(x = pipeline_i, y = distance)) + 
      geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, fill= "#5eb8e8ff", color = "#5eb8e8ff", outlier.size=0.8) + 
      my_theme(theme_classic) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
            legend.position = "none",
            plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
            panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "#EAEAEA", linewidth = 0.1)) +
      # ylim(0, 1) + 
      labs(x = "", title = "Between pipeline / within sample",  y = "Jaccard Similarity") 
      

  plt2 <- dist_df %>% 
    filter(between_pipeline == FALSE) %>% 
    mutate(pipeline_i = factor(pipeline_i, levels = pipelines, labels = pipelines_l)) %>% 
    ggplot(., aes(x = pipeline_i, y = distance)) + 
      geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, fill = "#72bf6cff", color = "#72bf6cff", outlier.size=0.8) + 
      my_theme(theme_classic) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
            legend.position = "none",
            plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
            panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "#EAEAEA", linewidth = 0.1)) +
      # ylim(0, 1) +
      labs(x = "", title = "Between samples / within pipeline",  y = "Jaccard Similarity") 
      

  combined <- (plt | plt1 | plt2) + 
    plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1.5, 1.5), guides = "collect") & 
    theme(legend.position = "none",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
      legend.key.width = unit(0.5, "cm"),
      legend.key.height = unit(0.5, "cm"))

  ggsave(paste0(plot_path, "SFigure_picrust_distance_", dist, ".pdf"), plot = combined, device = cairo_pdf, width = 7, height = 3)

  dist_df %>% 
    group_by(pipeline_i,between_pipeline) %>% 
    summarize(avg = mean(distance, na.rm=TRUE),
              sd = sd(distance, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop") %>%
    group_by(between_pipeline) %>%
    summarize(avg = mean(avg, na.rm=TRUE),
              sd = mean(sd, na.rm=TRUE))
}
```
