#### Plot hierarchical clustering matrices
```{r, plot_hclust, eval=FALSE}

comparison_results <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "dendrogram_comparisons_all.rds"))
m <- "cophenetic"
pltlist <- list()

for (mydist in c("aitchison", "jaccard")) {
  mat <- data.frame(comparison_results[[m]]) %>% 
    select(all_of(contains(mydist))) %>% 
    select(-ends_with("asv"), -ends_with("asv199")) %>% 
    rownames_to_column(var = "var") %>% 
    filter(grepl(mydist, var), !grepl("asv$|asv199$", var)) %>% 
    column_to_rownames(var = "var")

  dist_mat <- as.dist(1 - mat)
  pcoa <- wcmdscale(dist_mat, eig = TRUE) 

  eig      <- pcoa$eig
  eig_pos  <- eig[eig > 0]
  pct      <- round(eig_pos[1:2] / sum(eig_pos) * 100, 1)
  xlab     <- paste0("PCoA1 (", pct[1], "%)")
  ylab     <- paste0("PCoA2 (", pct[2], "%)")

  meta <- data.frame(
    label        = rownames(mat),
    dataset = str_extract(rownames(mat), "mock5|mock12|miseq_v4_sim|novaseq_v4_sim|gemsim|mindset|parkinson"),
    featlevel  = str_extract(rownames(mat), "asv|q2_gg|idtaxa_gg|q2|idtaxa|KO|cyc")
  ) %>% 
    mutate(dtype = case_when(dataset %in% mocks ~ "Mock", 
                            dataset %in% sims ~ "Simulation",
                            TRUE ~ "Real"),
          ftype = case_when(featlevel %in% c("q2_gg", "idtaxa_gg") ~ "Genus",
                            featlevel %in% c("q2", "idtaxa") ~ "Genus",
                            featlevel %in% c("KO", "cyc") ~ "PICRUSt",
                            featlevel %in% c("asv") ~ "ASV"),
          reference = case_when(grepl("_gg", featlevel) ~ "GreenGenes",
                                !grepl("_gg", featlevel) & featlevel %in% c("q2", "idtaxa") ~ "Silva",
                                TRUE ~ NA_character_))

  scores <- as.data.frame(pcoa$points) %>% 
    select(PCoA1 = Dim1, PCoA2 = Dim2) %>% 
    rownames_to_column(var = "label") 

  meta <- meta %>% 
    dplyr::left_join(., scores, by = "label") %>%
    mutate(dataset = factor(dataset, levels = datasets$datasets))

  pltlist[[paste0(mydist, "_p1")]] <- ggplot(meta, aes(PCoA1, PCoA2, color = dataset, shape = ftype)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey70") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey70") +
    geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
    # stat_ellipse(aes(group = dtype), linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.5) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = ylab,
          color = "Dataset", shape = "Feature level") +
    my_theme(theme_classic) +
    scale_color_manual(values = cols_d) +
    ggtitle(paste0(tools::toTitleCase(mydist))) 

  pltlist[[paste0(mydist, "_p2")]] <- ggplot(meta, aes(PCoA1, PCoA2, color = ftype, shape = dtype)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey70") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey70") +
    geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
    # stat_ellipse(aes(group = dtype), linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.5) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = ylab,
          color = "Feature level", shape = "Dataset type") +
    my_theme(theme_classic) +
    ggtitle(paste0(tools::toTitleCase(mydist))) 

  write_tsv(mat, file = paste0(output_path, "cophenitic_distance_", mydist, ".tsv"), col_names = TRUE)
}

combined <-  wrap_plots(pltlist, ncol = 2) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") & 
  theme(legend.position = "right",

    legend.key.width = unit(0.5, "cm"),

ggsave(paste0(plot_path, "SFigure_hclust_pcoa.pdf"),
```

```{r permanova_plot, eval=FALSE}
# ggsave(file = paste0(plot_path, "permanova_R2_pipeline.pdf"), plot = pltlist[["pipeline"]] , device = cairo_pdf, width = 8, height = 6)

  pltlist[[lev]][["delta"]] <- df_sub %>%
    filter(variable == "R2") %>%

    mutate(delta_R2 = value[pipeline == "all"] - value) %>%
    filter(pipeline != "all", !dataset %in% "mock12", distance %in% "aitchison") %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    ggplot(., aes(x = pipeline, y = delta_R2, fill = pipeline, color = pipeline)) +
```

```{r corall_union, eval=FALSE}

find_cols <- function(data, patterns) {
  Reduce(function(cols, pat) cols[grepl(pat, cols)], patterns, init = colnames(data))
}

stats_dataset <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "stats_dataset_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus_perctpfp_picrustrecall_mds_perm_cor_alpha2_beta_da2_z.rds"))

df_exp <- lapply(c(mocks, sims), function(d) {
  v <- c("cor", "clr", "exp")
  vars <- find_cols(stats_dataset[[d]], v)
  if (d %in% c(mocks, sims)) vars <- vars[grepl("exp", vars)]

  vars <- vars[!grepl("part", vars)]

  tmp <- stats_dataset[[d]] %>% 
    select(pipeline, all_of(vars)) %>%
    mutate(dataset = d) 

  # colnames(tmp) <- gsub("_exp", "", colnames(tmp))
  return(tmp)
  
}) %>% bind_rows() %>% 
pivot_longer(cols = -c(pipeline, dataset), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(exp = ifelse(dataset %in% c(mocks, sims), "expected", "consensus"),
         feat = sapply(str_split(variable, "_"), tail, 1),
         cor = case_when(grepl("part", variable) ~ "partial", 
                         grepl("union", variable) ~ "intersection",
                         TRUE ~ "union")) %>%
  filter(!feat %in% "gg") %>%
  mutate(feat = factor(feat, levels = c("asv", "deftax", "q2", "idtaxa", "KO", "cyc"), labels = c("ASV", "Pipeline Default", "Q2-NBC", "IDTAXA", "KO", "MetaCyc"))) %>%
  mutate(cor = factor(cor, levels = c("union", "intersection", "partial")))

df_real <- lapply(reals, function(d) {
  v <- c("cor", "clr")
  vars <- find_cols(stats_dataset[[d]], v)
  if (d %in% reals) vars <- vars[!grepl("asv$", vars)]

  vars <- vars[!grepl("part", vars)]

  tmp <- stats_dataset[[d]] %>% 
    select(pipeline, all_of(vars)) %>%
    mutate(dataset = d) 

  colnames(tmp) <- gsub("249", "", colnames(tmp))
  return(tmp)
  
}) %>% bind_rows() %>% 
pivot_longer(cols = -c(pipeline, dataset), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(exp = ifelse(dataset %in% c(mocks, sims), "expected", "consensus"),
         feat = sapply(str_split(variable, "_"), tail, 1),
         cor = case_when(grepl("part", variable) ~ "partial", 
                         grepl("union", variable) ~ "intersection",
                         TRUE ~ "union")) %>%
  filter(!feat %in% "gg") %>%
  mutate(feat = factor(feat, levels = c("asv", "deftax", "q2", "idtaxa", "KO", "cyc"), labels = c("ASV", "Pipeline Default", "Q2-NBC", "IDTAXA", "KO", "MetaCyc"))) %>% 
  mutate(cor = factor(cor, levels = c("union", "intersection", "partial")))

df <- rbind(df_exp, df_real) %>%

  filter(!is.na(value)) %>%

p1 <- df %>%

    geom_hline(yintercept=0, linewidth = 0.05, color = "black") +
    geom_line(aes(group = interaction(dataset,pipeline)), 
              linewidth = 0.1,
```

### Between classifier concordance
```{r tax_conc, eval=FALSE}

concordance <- data.frame(dataset = character(),
                          pipeline = character(),
                          comb = character(),
                          phylum = numeric(),
                          class = numeric(),
                          order = numeric(),
                          family = numeric(),
                          genus = numeric(),
                          na1 = numeric(),
                          na2 = numeric(),
                          partial = numeric(),
                          mismatch = numeric())

alloverlaps <- list()
pltlist <- list()
pages <- list()

for (d in datasets$datasets) {

    tse_q2 <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_", "q2_", d, "_asv_list_allpipelines.rds"))
    tse_idtaxa <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_", "idtaxa_", d, "_asv_list_allpipelines.rds"))
    tse_q2.gg <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_", "q2_gg_", d, "_asv_list_allpipelines.rds"))
    tse_idtaxa.gg <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_", "idtaxa_gg_", d, "_asv_list_allpipelines.rds"))

    tse_def <- readRDS(paste0(output_path, "tse_deftax_", d, "_allpipelines.rds"))

    for (p in pipelines) {

      comb_skip <- character()

      if (p %in% "Expected") next
      print(paste(d, "|", p))

      if (is.null(tse_def[[p]])) next

      for (s in c("_q2", "_idtaxa", "_def", "_q2.gg", "_idtaxa.gg")) {
        tse_tmp <- get(paste0("tse", s))
        tse_tmp_sub <- tse_tmp[[p]]
        
        if (is.null(tse_tmp_sub)) {
          assign(paste0("tax", s), NULL)
          assign(paste0("tse", s, "_sub"), NULL)
          comb_skip <- c(comb_skip, gsub("_", "", s))
          next
        }

        tax_tmp <- sapply(colnames(rowData(tse_tmp_sub)), function(x) gsub(" ", "_", rowData(tse_tmp_sub)[[x]])) %>% data.frame()
        tax_tmp$kingdom <- NULL
        tax_tmp$domain <- NULL
        tax_tmp$species <- NULL

        assign(paste0("tse", s, "_sub"), tse_tmp)
        assign(paste0("tax", s), tax_tmp)
      }

      # Check
      identical(rownames(tax_def), rownames(tax_q2)) 
      identical(rownames(tax_q2), rownames(tax_idtaxa))     
      identical(rownames(tax_idtaxa.gg), rownames(tax_q2))

      skip_bool <- length(comb_skip) != 0
      if (length(comb_skip) > 1) comb_skip <- paste(comb_skip, "|")

      for (comb in c("def_q2", "def_idtaxa", "q2_idtaxa",
                     "def_q2.gg", "def_idtaxa.gg", "q2.gg_idtaxa.gg",
                     "q2_q2.gg", "idtaxa_idtaxa.gg")) {


        if (skip_bool) {
          if (grepl(comb_skip, comb)) next
        }

        perc_overlap <- data.frame(dataset = d,
                                  pipeline = p,
                                  comb = comb,
                                  phylum = NA,
                                  class = NA,
                                  order = NA,
                                  family = NA,
                                  genus = NA,
                                  na1 = 0,
                                  na2 = 0,
                                  partial = 0,
                                  mismatch = 0)
                                
        clas1 <- (str_split(comb, "_") %>% unlist())[1]
        clas2 <- (str_split(comb, "_") %>% unlist())[2]


        tax1 <- get(paste0("tax_", clas1))
        tax2 <- get(paste0("tax_", clas2))
        
        for (n in colnames(tax1)) {
          tmp <- data.frame(clas1 = tax1[[n]],
                        clas2 = tax2[[n]])

          tmp$conc <- ifelse((is.na(tax1[[n]]) & !is.na(tax2[[n]])) | (is.na(tax2[[n]]) & !is.na(tax1[[n]])), FALSE, tax1[[n]] == tax2[[n]])
          tmp$conc[(is.na(tax1[[n]]) & is.na(tax2[[n]]))] <- TRUE

          perc_overlap[[n]][1] <- sum(tmp$conc) / length(tmp$conc) 

          tmp_sub <- tmp %>% filter(conc == FALSE) 

          if (n %in% "genus" & nrow(tmp_sub) > 0) {
            tmp_sub$mismatch_reason <- case_when(
              is.na(tmp_sub$clas1) & !is.na(tmp_sub$clas2) ~ "na1",
              is.na(tmp_sub$clas2) & !is.na(tmp_sub$clas1) ~ "na2",
              sapply(1:nrow(tmp_sub), function(n) grepl(tmp_sub$clas1[n], tmp_sub$clas2[n], fixed = TRUE)) ~ "partial",
              sapply(1:nrow(tmp_sub), function(n) grepl(tmp_sub$clas2[n], tmp_sub$clas1[n], fixed = TRUE)) ~ "partial",
              TRUE ~ "mismatch")

            reason_props <- summary(factor(tmp_sub$mismatch_reason)) / nrow(tmp_sub)
            
            perc_overlap$na1[1] <- ifelse("na1" %in% names(reason_props), reason_props["na1"], 0)
            perc_overlap$na2[1] <- ifelse("na2" %in% names(reason_props), reason_props["na2"], 0)
            perc_overlap$partial[1] <- ifelse("partial" %in% names(reason_props), reason_props["partial"], 0)
            perc_overlap$mismatch[1] <- ifelse("mismatch" %in% names(reason_props), reason_props["mismatch"], 0)

            alloverlaps[[d]][[p]][[comb]][[n]] <- list(conc = tmp, disconc = tmp_sub) 
          } else {
            alloverlaps[[d]][[p]][[comb]][[n]] <- list(conc = tmp)
          }

        }

        concordance <- concordance %>%
          add_row(perc_overlap)
      }

    }

    plt <- concordance %>%
      filter(dataset %in% d) %>%
      mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = pipelines)) %>% 
      mutate(comb = factor(comb, levels = c("def_q2", "def_idtaxa", "q2_idtaxa",
                                            "def_q2.gg", "def_idtaxa.gg", "q2.gg_idtaxa.gg",
                                            "q2_q2.gg", "idtaxa_idtaxa.gg"), 
                                labels = c("Default vs. q2", "Default vs. idtaxa", "q2 vs. idtaxa",
                                           "Default vs. q2 (gg)", "Default vs. idtaxa (gg)", "q2 (gg) vs. idtaxa (gg)",
                                           "q2 (silva) vs. q2 (gg)", "idtaxa (silva) vs. idtaxa(gg)"))) %>%
      ggplot(.) +
        geom_bar(aes(x = pipeline, y = phylum, fill = factor("Phylum",
                              levels = c("Phylum","Class","Order","Family","Genus"))), stat = "identity") +
        geom_bar(aes(x = pipeline, y = class, fill = factor("Class",
                              levels = c("Phylum","Class","Order","Family","Genus"))), stat = "identity") +
        geom_bar(aes(x = pipeline, y = order, fill = factor("Order",
                              levels = c("Phylum","Class","Order","Family","Genus"))), stat = "identity") +
        geom_bar(aes(x = pipeline, y = family, fill = factor("Family",
                              levels = c("Phylum","Class","Order","Family","Genus"))), stat = "identity") +
        geom_bar(aes(x = pipeline, y = genus, fill = factor("Genus",
                              levels = c("Phylum","Class","Order","Family","Genus"))), stat = "identity") +
        my_theme(theme_bw) +
        facet_wrap(~comb, ncol = 3, nrow = 3) +
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
              labs(y = "", x = "", fill = "Taxonomic level") +
        scale_fill_manual(values = c("Phylum" = "#320A6B",
                                      "Class" = "#065084",
                                      "Order" = "#4b94be",
                                      "Family" = "#0F828C",
                                      "Genus" = "#78B9B5")) +
        theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5)) +
        labs(y = "% identical assignments") +
        scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent,
                          limits = c(0, 1.02), 
                          expand = c(0, 0)) 
    
    pdf(NULL)
    pages[[d]] <- arrangeGrob(plt, 
                              top = textGrob(titles_d[[d]],
                              gp = gpar(fontsize = 15, fontface = "bold", fontfamily = "Montserrat")),
                              left = textGrob(rev(c("Default vs. q2/IDTAXA (silva)", "Default vs. q2/IDTAXA (gg)","Silva vs GreenGenes")), 
                              rot = 0, 
                              gp = gpar(fontsize = 8, fontface = "bold", fontfamily = "Montserrat"),
                              y = seq(0.2, 0.80, length.out = 3),
                              just = "left",
                              x=0.1))
    dev.off()
}

pdf(paste0(plot_path, "SFigure_classifier_concordance", ".pdf"),
    width = 12, height = 7)
for (p in pages) {
  grid.newpage()
  grid.draw(p)
}
dev.off()
  
concordance <- concordance %>%
  mutate(dataset = factor(dataset, levels = datasets$datasets)) %>%
  mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = pipelines))

alloverlaps[["concordance"]] <- concordance
```

### Taxonomic mismatch reasons 
> NA in one of the classifiers (na1 = first classifier, na2 = second classifier)
> Partial match (substring match, eg prevotella and prevotella_9)
> Complete mismatch  
```{r mismatch_reason, eval=FALSE}

alloverlaps <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "concordance_taxonomy.rds"))
concordance <- alloverlaps$concordance
pages <- list()

for (d in datasets$datasets) {
  conc_sub <- concordance %>%
    filter(dataset %in% d) %>% 
    mutate(concordant = genus,
           discordant = 1 - genus,
           na1 = na1 * discordant,
           na2 = na2 * discordant,
           partial = partial * discordant,
           mismatch = mismatch * discordant) %>%
    select(comb, pipeline, concordant, na1, na2, partial, mismatch) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(concordant, na1, na2, partial, mismatch), 
                 names_to = "category", 
                 values_to = "percentage") %>%
    mutate(category = factor(category, levels = rev(c("concordant", "partial", "mismatch", "na2", "na1")))) %>%
    mutate(comb = factor(comb, levels = c("def_q2", "def_idtaxa", "q2_idtaxa",
                                            "def_q2.gg", "def_idtaxa.gg", "q2.gg_idtaxa.gg",
                                            "q2_q2.gg", "idtaxa_idtaxa.gg"), 
                                labels = c("Default vs. Q2-NBC", "Default vs. IDTAXA", "Q2-NBC vs. IDTAXA",
                                           "Default vs. Q2-NBC (gg)", "Default vs. IDTAXA (gg)", "Q2-NBC (gg) vs. IDTAXA (gg)",
                                           "Q2-NBC (silva) vs. Q2-NBC (gg)", "IDTAXA (silva) vs. IDTAXA(gg)"))) %>%
    mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = pipelines, labels = pipelines_l))

  plt <- conc_sub %>%
    ggplot(., aes(x = pipeline, y = percentage, fill = category)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
    facet_wrap(~comb, ncol=3, nrow=4) +
    my_theme(theme_bw) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    labs(x = "") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("concordant" = "#9DCB7D",
                                    "partial" = "#C9E2B8",
                                    "na1" = "#c7c7c7d2",
                                    "na2" = "#929292ff",
                                    "mismatch" = "#D39895")) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent,
                       limits = c(0, 1.02), 
                       expand = c(0, 0)) 
  
  pdf(NULL)
  pages[[d]] <- arrangeGrob(plt, 
                            top = textGrob(titles_d[[d]],
                            gp = gpar(fontsize = 15, fontface = "bold", fontfamily = "Montserrat")),
                            left = textGrob(rev(c("Default vs. Q2-NBC/IDTAXA (silva)", "Default vs. Q2-NBC/IDTAXA (gg)","Silva vs GreenGenes")), 
                            rot = 0, 
                            gp = gpar(fontsize = 8, fontface = "bold", fontfamily = "Montserrat"),
                            y = seq(0.2, 0.80, length.out = 3),
                            just = "left",
                            x=0.1))
  dev.off()

}
```

## Statistical Evaluation
### Alpha Diversity 
#### Correlations between alpha diversity indices
```{r alpha_id_cor, eval=FALSE}

pages <- list()
pltlist <- list()

for (d in c(sims, reals)) {
  print(d)
  tse <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "tse_q2_", d, "_asv_meta_alpha_allpipelines.rds"))
  meta <- data.frame(colData(tse)) %>% 
    select(-chao1_richness_se)

  alpha_cor <- lapply(unique(meta$pipeline), function(p) {
    meta %>% filter(pipeline %in% p) %>% 
    select(all_of(contains("diversity")), 
          all_of(contains("richness")),
          all_of(contains("evenness")),
          all_of(contains("dominance"))) %>%
             cor(., method = "pearson")
  })
  names(alpha_cor) <- unique(meta$pipeline)

  # Plt per pipeline
  plt <- lapply(names(alpha_cor), function(a) {
    toplt <- alpha_cor[[a]]
    ggcorrplot(alpha_cor[[a]], 
            method = "square", 
            type = "lower",
            lab = FALSE,
            lab_size = 3) +
    ggtitle(a) + 
    my_theme(theme_classic) + 
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),  
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      axis.line = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.line.x = element_line(colour = "black"),
      axis.line.y = element_line(colour = "black"),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
  })
    
  combined <- wrap_plots(plt, ncol = 4, nrow=4) +
    plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
    theme(legend.position = "top",
          legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
          legend.key.width = unit(0.3, "cm"),
          legend.key.height = unit(0.4, "cm"))

  # Convert to grob and add labels
  pdf(NULL)
  final_plot <- patchworkGrob(combined)
  dev.off()

  pages[[d]] <- arrangeGrob(final_plot, 
              top = textGrob(titles_d[[d]],
                    gp = gpar(fontsize = 15, fontface = "bold", fontfamily = "Montserrat")))

  # Average plot
  alpha_array <- simplify2array(alpha_cor) 
  alpha_ave <- apply(alpha_array, 1:2, mean, na.rm = TRUE) # Calc average across elements 

  pltlist[[d]] <- alpha_ave %>% as.data.frame() %>% 
    ggcorrplot(., 
            method = "square", 
            type = "lower",
            lab = FALSE,
            lab_size = 3) +
    ggtitle(titles_d[[d]]) + 
    my_theme(theme_classic) + 
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),  
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      axis.line = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.line.x = element_line(colour = "black"),
      axis.line.y = element_line(colour = "black"),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

}
```

#### Alpha diversity group comparisons 
```{r plot_alpha, eval=FALSE}

pltlist <- list()
alpha_mods <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "alpha_models_lm.rds")) 

for (d in c(sims, reals)) {

  tmp <- alpha_mods[[d]][["meta"]] %>% 
    filter(!pipeline %in% "LotuS2_otu") %>% 
    mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = pipelines, labels = pipelines_l))

  # Plot alpha distribution per dataset
  pltlist[["all"]][[d]] <- tmp %>% 
    ggplot(., aes(x=diversity, y = pipeline, color = pipeline, fill = pipeline)) +
      geom_density_ridges(alpha = 0.5, linewidth=1) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c(Expected = "#A6A6A6"), cols_p) +
      scale_color_manual(values = cols_p) +
      my_theme(theme_bw) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
      guides(fill = "none", color = "none") +
      facet_wrap(~index, scales="free_x") +
      labs(x = "", y = "")  
  
  if (!d %in% "mindset") {
    # Density plot for categorical variable
    pltlist[["groups"]][[d]] <- tmp %>% 
      ggplot(., aes(x=diversity, y = pipeline, color = label)) +
        geom_density_ridges(alpha=0, linewidth=0.5) +
        my_theme(theme_bw) +
        # scale_fill_manual(values = cols_cs) +
        scale_color_manual(values = c("#81cdd4ff", "#263434ff")) +
        labs(x = "", y = "", title = titles_d[[d]]) +
        theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
        facet_wrap(~index, scales = "free_x")  
  } else {
    # Scatter plot for continuous variable
    pltlist[["groups"]][[d]] <- alpha_mods[[d]][["meta"]] %>% 
      ggplot(., aes(x=RC1, y = diversity, color = pipeline)) +
        geom_point(size= 1, alpha = 0.6) +
        my_theme(theme_bw) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = cols_p) +
        scale_color_manual(values = cols_p) +
        labs(x = "Negative Valence", y = "diversity", title = titles_d[[d]]) +
        theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
        facet_wrap(~index, scales = "free_y", nrow=2) +
        guides(color = "none", fill = "none") 
  }   

  pltlist[["stats"]][[d]] <- alpha_mods[[d]][["mods"]] %>%
    filter(!pipeline %in% "LotuS2_otu") %>% 
    mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = rev(pipelines), labels = rev(pipelines_l)),
           alpha = factor(alpha, levels = c("observed_richness", "shannon_diversity"), 
                                 labels = c("Observed Richness", "Shannon Diversity")),
           sig = p < 0.05) %>% 
    ggplot(., aes(y = pipeline, x = est)) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.5) +
      geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = CIl, xmax = CIh, color = col, alpha = p<0.05), 
                        height = 0.3, linewidth = 0.8, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
      geom_point(aes(color = col, alpha = p<0.05), size = 3, shape = 18, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c(exp="#A6A6A6",
                                    obs="#7abd75ff",
                                    shan="#f7bd00ff")) +
      scale_alpha_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 1, "FALSE" = 0.5)) +
      my_theme(theme_bw) +
      facet_wrap(~alpha) +
      xlim(-0.65, 0.65) +
      guides(color = "none") +
      theme(legend.position = "bottom",
            plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
      labs(x = "Regression coefficient", y = "", title = titles_d[[d]])
}
```

```{r plot_beta, eval=FALSE}
allperm <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "group_permanova.rds"))
pltlist <- list()

for (d in c(sims, reals)) {
  for (mydist in c("aitchison", "jaccard")) {

    pltlist[[mydist]][["F"]][[d]] <- allperm[[mydist]][[d]] %>%
      ggplot(., aes(x = pipeline, y = F, fill = pipeline == "Expected", alpha = p < 0.05)) +
        geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
        scale_fill_manual(values = c("#D3D3D3", "#a3a3a3ff")) +

        labs(x = "", title = titles_d[[d]]) +

    pltlist[[mydist]][["R2"]][[d]] <- allperm[[mydist]][[d]] %>%

        geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
        scale_fill_manual(values = c("#D3D3D3", "#a3a3a3ff")) +
        scale_alpha_manual(values = c("FALSE"=0.5, "TRUE"=1)) +

  }
}
```

```{r plot_da, eval=FALSE}

da_stats <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "differential_abundance_stats.rds"))
df_comb <- da_stats$df 

all_mats <- readRDS(paste0(output_path, "da_corstats.rds")) # All correlation matrices
all_df <- readRDS(paste0(output_path, "da_probsig.rds")) # All summary stats including probability 

#  Plot summary stats distribution per dataset and classifier 
pltlist <- lapply(c("est", "SE", "pval", "padj"), function(stat) {
  plt <- df_comb %>%
    mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = rev(pipelines)),
           dataset = factor(dataset, levels = datasets$datasets)) %>%
    ggplot(., aes(x = .data[[stat]], y = pipeline, fill = pipeline, color = pipeline)) +
      geom_density_ridges(alpha = 0.5) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = cols_p) +
      scale_color_manual(values = cols_p) +
      my_theme(theme_bw) +
      facet_wrap(~ classifier + dataset, ncol=5,scales = "free_x") +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1),
            plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
            panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "lightgrey", linewidth=0.05),
            legend.position = "none") +
      labs(x = stat, y = "", title = stat)
  
  pdf(NULL)
  final_plot <- arrangeGrob(plt, 
              top = textGrob(stat,
                              gp = gpar(fontsize = 15, fontface = "bold", fontfamily = "Montserrat")),
              left = textGrob(rev(c("Default", "Q2 Naive Bayes", "IDTAXA")), 
                              rot = 0, 
                              gp = gpar(fontsize = 8, fontface = "bold", fontfamily = "Montserrat"),
                              y = seq(0.15, 0.85, length.out = 3),
                              just = "left",
                              x=0.1))
  dev.off()

  return(final_plot)

})

# Average difference to mean (for real datasets) or expected (for simulated datasets)
pltlist <- list()
for (d in c(sims, reals)) {
  for (c in c(classifiers)) {
    
    mytitle <- ifelse(c %in% "q2", titles_d[[d]], "")
    df <- all_df[[d]][[c]]

    df_exp <- df_comb %>% filter(dataset %in% d, pipeline %in% "Expected")
    df <- df %>% dplyr::left_join(., df_exp %>% select(genus, est_exp = est), by = "genus") %>% 
      mutate(exp_diff = est_exp - est) %>%
      mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = rev(pipelines)))
    
    if (d %in% reals) {
      pltlist[[c]][[d]] <- df %>%
        ggplot(., aes(x = est_diff, y = pipeline, fill = pipeline, color = pipeline)) +
          geom_density_ridges(alpha = 0.5) +
          scale_fill_manual(values = cols_p) +
          scale_color_manual(values = cols_p) +
          my_theme(theme_bw) +
          theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1),
                plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
                panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "lightgrey", linewidth=0.05)) +
          labs(x = "Beta difference to mean", y = "", title = mytitle)
    } else {
      pltlist[[c]][[d]] <- df %>%
        filter(!pipeline %in% "Expected") %>%
        ggplot(., aes(x = exp_diff, y = pipeline, fill = pipeline, color = pipeline)) +
          geom_density_ridges(alpha = 0.5) +
          scale_fill_manual(values = cols_p) +
          scale_color_manual(values = cols_p) +
          my_theme(theme_bw) +
          theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1),
                plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
                panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "lightgrey", linewidth=0.05)) +
          labs(x = "Beta difference to expected", y = "", title = mytitle)
    }
  }
}

# Plot for each genus the proportion of significant hits across pipelines + pvalues  
pltlist <- list()
p_thres <- 0.05

for (d in c(sims, reals)) {
  for (c in classifiers) {

    mytitle <- ifelse(c %in% "q2", titles_d[[d]], "")

    df_any <- all_df[[d]][[c]] %>% filter(prop_sig > 0)

    order <- df_any %>%
      filter(prop_sig > 0) %>%
      arrange(desc(prop_sig)) %>%
      pull(genus) %>%
      unique()

    df_plot <- df_any %>%
      filter(prop_sig > 0) %>%
      arrange(desc(prop_sig)) %>%
      mutate(genus = factor(genus, levels = order))

    bg_data <- df_plot %>%
      group_by(genus) %>%
      summarise(prop_sig = mean(prop_sig, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
      mutate(
        bg_color = case_when(
          prop_sig >= 1    ~ "#319F2C",
          prop_sig >= 0.75 ~ "#91E58D",
          prop_sig >= 0.50 ~ "#f5da6dff",
          prop_sig >= 0.25 ~ "#F6AE2D",
          TRUE             ~ "#BB0D0D"),
        genus_num = as.numeric(factor(genus, levels = order))  # ✅ use `order`
      )

    pltlist[["pval_bg"]][[c]][[d]]  <- df_any %>%
      filter(prop_sig > 0) %>% 
      arrange(desc(prop_sig)) %>% 
      mutate(genus = factor(genus, levels = order)) %>% 
      ggplot(., aes(x = genus, y = padj)) +
        # Add background rectangles using lapply
        lapply(1:nrow(bg_data), function(i) {
          annotate("rect",
                  xmin = bg_data$genus_num[i] - 0.5,
                  xmax = bg_data$genus_num[i] + 0.5,
                  ymin = 0, ymax = 1,
                  fill = bg_data$bg_color[i],
                  alpha = 0.3)}) +
        geom_jitter(width=0.007, size = 1, aes(color=pipeline, fill=pipeline)) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = cols_p) +
        scale_color_manual(values = cols_p) +
        geom_hline(yintercept = 0.05, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
        my_theme(theme_classic) +
        labs(title = mytitle, x = "", y = "p(fdr)") +
        ylim(c(0,1)) +
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
              plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
              panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "lightgrey", linewidth=0.05)) +
        theme(axis.title.x=element_blank(),
          axis.text.x=element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.x=element_blank())

    pltlist[["probsig"]][[c]][[d]] <- df_any %>%
      filter(padj < 0.05) %>% 
      group_by(pipeline, propsig_cat) %>%
      summarize(n = n_distinct(genus), .groups = "drop") %>%
      complete(pipeline, propsig_cat = factor(c("100%", "75-99%", "50-74%", "25-49%", "0-24%"), 
                           levels = c("100%", "75-99%", "50-74%", "25-49%", "0-24%")),
           fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
      filter(!pipeline %in% "eDNAFlow") %>%
      mutate(propsig_cat = factor(propsig_cat, levels = c("100%", "75-99%", "50-74%", "25-49%", "0-24%"))) %>%
      mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = pipelines)) %>%
      ggplot(., aes(x = pipeline, y = n, fill = propsig_cat)) +
      geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill") +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c(
          "100%" = "#319F2C",
          "75-99%" = "#91E58D",
          "50-74%" = "#f5da6dff",
          "25-49%" = "#F6AE2D",
          "0-24%" = "#BB0D0D")) +
      my_theme(theme_classic) + 
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
      labs(title = mytitle, x = "", y = "% of associated genera", fill = "Proportion significant")

    for (var in c("prev", "ab", "stat", "pval", "padj", "est")) { 
      t <- ifelse(c %in% "q2", titles_d[[d]], "")
      pltlist[[var]][[c]][[d]] <- df_any %>%
        filter(prop_sig > 0, padj < 0.05) %>% 
        ggplot(., aes(x = propsig_cat, y=abs(.data[[var]]), fill = propsig_cat, color=propsig_cat)) +
          geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.3, outliers=FALSE) + 
          geom_jitter(width = 0.1, size = 1) +
          my_theme(theme_bw) +
          labs(x = "", title = t, y=var) +
          scale_fill_manual(values = c(
            "100%" = "#319F2C",
            "75-99%" = "#91E58D",
            "50-74%" = "#f5da6dff",
            "25-49%" = "#F6AE2D",
            "0-24%" = "#BB0D0D")) +
            scale_color_manual(values = c(
            "100%" = "#319F2C",
            "75-99%" = "#91E58D",
            "50-74%" = "#f5da6dff",
            "25-49%" = "#F6AE2D",
            "0-24%" = "#BB0D0D")) +
          theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
          labs(y = paste0("absolute(", var, ")"))
      
    }
  }
}
```

```{r mpred, eval=FALSE}
stats_dataset <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "stats_dataset_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus_perctpfp_picrustrecall_mds_perm_cor_alpha2_beta_da2_z.rds"))

df_real <- lapply(reals, function(d) {
  stats_dataset[[d]] %>% 
    select(pipeline, all_of(contains("da_est_ave_")), all_of(contains("da_overlap_ave_"))) %>%
    select(pipeline, all_of(contains("_q2"))) %>% 
    mutate(dataset = d)
}) %>% bind_rows() %>%
  pivot_longer(cols=-c(pipeline, dataset), names_to="variable", values_to="value") %>%
  mutate(exp = "consensus",
         classifier = ifelse(grepl("q2", variable), "q2", "idtaxa"),
         var = ifelse(grepl("est", variable), "Correlation", "Jaccard"),
         pred = ifelse(grepl("mpred", variable), "Covariate", "Outcome"))

df_exp <- lapply(sims, function(d) {
  stats_dataset[[d]] %>% 
    select(pipeline, all_of(contains("da_est_exp_")), all_of(contains("da_overlap_exp_")), all_of(contains("da_recall")), all_of(contains("da_precision"))) %>%
    select(pipeline, all_of(contains("_q2"))) %>% 
    mutate(dataset = d)
}) %>% bind_rows() %>%
  pivot_longer(cols=-c(pipeline, dataset), names_to="variable", values_to="value") %>%
  mutate(exp = "expected",
         classifier = ifelse(grepl("q2", variable), "q2", "idtaxa"),
         var = case_when(grepl("est", variable) ~ "Correlation", 
                         grepl("precision", variable) ~ "Precision",
                         grepl("recall", variable) ~ "Recall",
                         TRUE ~ "Jaccard"),
         pred = ifelse(grepl("mpred", variable), "Covariate", "Outcome")) %>%
  filter(!var %in% "Jaccard")
```

#### Ground-truth metrics 
```{r filt_sim, eval=FALSE}

prev_df <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "filtering_settings.rds"))
prev_df$filttype[prev_df$filttype %in% "short_seq"] <- "short"
prev_df$filttype[prev_df$filttype %in% "long_seq"] <- "long"
colnames(prev_df)[colnames(prev_df) %in% "precicion"] <- "precision"

pltlist <- list()
pages <- list()
titles <- c("precision" = "Precision",
            "recall" = "Recall",
            "jaccard" = "Jaccard",
            "cor" = "CLR correlation")

df_nofilt <- lapply(reals, function(d) {
  readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "filtering_settings_real_", d, "_nofilt", ".rds")) %>%
  mutate(dataset = d)
}) %>% bind_rows() 

for (filt in c("prev", "count", "short", "long")) {
  
  filt_df <- lapply(reals, function(d) {
    readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "filtering_settings_real_", d, "_", filt, ".rds")) %>%
    mutate(dataset = d)
  }) %>% bind_rows() 

  tmp <- df_nofilt
  tmp$filttype <- filt
  if (filt %in% c("prev", "count")) {
    tmp$threshold[tmp$filttype %in% filt] <- 1
  } else {
    tmp$threshold[tmp$filttype %in% filt] <- 0
  }

  filt_df <- filt_df %>% 
    bind_rows(tmp) 
    
  for (var in c("precision", "recall", "jaccard", "cor")) {
    
    if (var %in% c("precision", "recall")) { 
      tmp <- prev_df %>% 
        filter(!pipeline %in% "LotuS2_otu") %>% 
        filter(filttype %in% filt) %>% 
        mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = pipelines, labels = pipelines_l))
    } else {
      tmp <- filt_df %>% 
        filter(!pipeline %in% "LotuS2_otu") %>% 
        mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = pipelines, labels = pipelines_l))        
    }

    for (cs in c("cols_p", "cols_d")) {

      if (cs %in% "cols_p") {
        f <- "pipeline"
      } else {
        f <- "dataset"
      }

      pltlist[[cs]][[filt]][[var]] <- tmp %>% 
            ggplot(., aes(x = factor(threshold), y = .data[[var]])) +
              geom_line(aes(group = interaction(pipeline,dataset), fill = .data[[f]], color = .data[[f]])) +
              geom_point(aes(fill = .data[[f]], color = .data[[f]])) +
              scale_color_manual(values = get(cs)) +
              scale_fill_manual(values = get(cs)) +
              my_theme(theme_classic) +
              theme(legend.position="right",
                    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "lightgrey", linewidth=0.05),
                    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "lightgrey", linewidth=0.05)) +
              coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
              # theme(plot.margin = margin(5, 40, 5, 5)) +
              # guides(fill = "none", color = "none") +
              labs(x = ifelse(filt %in% "count", "threshold (>=)", ""),
                  title = ifelse(filt %in% "prev", titles[names(titles) %in% var], "")) +
              theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) + 
              ylim(c(0,1))
    }

  }
}

for (cs in c("cols_p", "cols_d")) {
  plt <- wrap_plots(pltlist[[cs]][["prev"]], ncol = 4) /
         wrap_plots(pltlist[[cs]][["count"]], ncol = 4) /
```

```{r filt_real, eval=FALSE}

titles <- c("precision" = "Precision",
            "recall" = "Recall",
            "jaccard" = "Jaccard",
            "cor" = "CLR correlation")

prev_df <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "filtering_settings.rds"))
prev_df$filttype[prev_df$filttype %in% "short_seq"] <- "short"
prev_df$filttype[prev_df$filttype %in% "long_seq"] <- "long"
colnames(prev_df)[colnames(prev_df) %in% "precicion"] <- "precision"


##### % improvement / deterioration sim
p_change <- data.frame(pipeline = character(),
                        dataset = character(),
                        filt = character(),
                        var = character(),
                        perc_change = numeric())

for (d in c(sims, reals)) {
  for (filt in c("prev", "count", "short", "long")) {

    df_nofilt <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "filtering_settings_real_", d, "_nofilt", ".rds"))
    filt_df <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "filtering_settings_real_", d, "_", filt, ".rds"))

    df_nofilt$filttype <- filt
    if (filt %in% c("prev", "count")) {
      df_nofilt$threshold[df_nofilt$filttype %in% filt] <- 1
    } else {
      df_nofilt$threshold[df_nofilt$filttype %in% filt] <- 0
    }

    filt_df <- filt_df %>% 
      bind_rows(df_nofilt)
        
    for (var in c("precision", "recall", "jaccard", "cor")) {

      if (d %in% reals & var %in% c("precision", "recall")) next
      if (d %in% sims & var %in% c("jaccard", "cor")) next

      print(paste(d, filt, var))
      
      if (var %in% c("precision", "recall")) { 
        tmp <- prev_df %>% 
          filter(dataset %in% d) %>%
          filter(!pipeline %in% "LotuS2_otu") %>% 
          filter(filttype %in% filt) %>% 
          mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = pipelines, labels = pipelines_l))
      } else {
        tmp <- filt_df %>%
          filter(!pipeline %in% "LotuS2_otu") %>% 
          mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = pipelines, labels = pipelines_l))        
      }
     
      
      nofilt_threshold <- ifelse(filt %in% c("prev", "count"), 1, 0)
      
      nofilt <- tmp %>% 
        filter(dataset %in% d) %>% 
        filter(filttype == filt, threshold == nofilt_threshold) %>%
        select(pipeline, .data[[var]])

      # nofilt_df <- data.frame(pipeline = unique(tmp$pipeline), 
      #                         var = var, 
      #                         filt = "no_filter", 
      #                         dataset =d, 
      #                         perc_change=0)

      # p_change <- p_change %>%
      #   bind_rows(nofilt_df)
      
      t <- case_when(filt %in% c("short", "long") ~ 1,
                     filt %in% "prev" ~ 2,
                     filt %in% "count" ~ 3)

      prev_sub <- tmp %>% 
        filter(dataset %in% d) %>% 
        filter(filttype %in% filt) %>% 
        filter(threshold == t) %>% 
        select(pipeline, .data[[var]]) 

      percentage <- prev_sub %>%
        dplyr::left_join(nofilt %>% select(pipeline, nofilt = .data[[var]]), by = "pipeline") %>%
        mutate(perc_change = (.data[[var]] - nofilt) / nofilt * 100) %>%
        select(pipeline, perc_change) %>%
        mutate(dataset = d, filt = filt, var = var)

      p_change <- p_change %>%
        bind_rows(percentage) 

    }
  }
}

p_change <- p_change %>%
  mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = pipelines_l)) %>%
  mutate(var = factor(var, levels = c("precision", "recall", "jaccard", "cor"), 
                           labels = c("Precision", "Recall", "Jaccard", "Correlation"))) %>%
  mutate(filt = factor(filt, levels = c("prev", "count", "short", "long"),
                             labels = c("Prevalence (>=2)", "Counts (>=3)", "Short seq. (<=240)", "Long seq. (>=260)")))

p1 <- p_change %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = filt, y = perc_change)) +
    stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "bar", position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), color ="#606568ff", fill="#606568ff") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
    geom_point(size = 1, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), aes(color=dataset, fill=dataset)) + 
    # geom_line(aes(group = interaction(dataset,pipeline)), color = dataset, linewidth = 0.1, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
    my_theme(theme_bw) + 
    scale_fill_manual(values = cols_d) +
    scale_color_manual(values = cols_d)  +
    facet_wrap(~var, ncol=2) +
    guides(fill = "none", color = "none") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 1),
                             limits = c(-50, 250), 
                             expand = c(0, 0)) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
    labs(x = "", y = "% change", title = "Effect of ASV-level filtering")

ggsave(paste0(plot_path, "SFigure_filtering_percchange.pdf"), plot = p1, device = cairo_pdf, width = 5, height = 5)
```

```{r fig4, eval=FALSE}
stats_dataset <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "stats_dataset_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus_perctpfp_picrustrecall_mds_perm_cor_alpha2_beta_da2_z.rds"))
stats_sample <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "stats_sample_picrust_wrecall_wprecision_genus_picrustrecall.rds"))
distlist <- readRDS(file = paste0(output_path, "hclust_distance_matrices.rds"))
pltlist <- list()

for (lev in c("q2", "idtaxa")) {

    # Genus yield
    df_sub <- lapply(datasets$datasets, function(d) {
        vars <- c("pipeline", paste0("num_genus_", lev))
        if (d %in% reals) {
            vars <- c(vars, paste0("distave_jaccard_", lev), paste0("cor_clr_", lev))
        } else {
            vars <- c(vars, paste0("distexp_jaccard_", lev), paste0("cor_clr_exp_", lev))
        }

        tmp <- stats_dataset[[d]] %>% select(all_of(vars)) %>% 
            mutate(dataset = d)

        colnames(tmp) <- c("pipeline", "genus", "dist", "cor", "dataset")
        tmp$dist <- 1 - tmp$dist # convert to similarity
        return(tmp)
    }) %>% bind_rows() 
    
    df_var <- df_sub %>%
        add_row(data.frame(dataset = "mock5", pipeline = "Expected", genus = 18)) %>%
        add_row(data.frame(dataset = "miseq_v4_sim", pipeline = "Expected", genus = 282)) %>%
        mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = pipelines, pipelines_l)) %>%
        mutate(dataset = factor(dataset, level = datasets$datasets))
      
    df_sub2 <- df_var %>% 
      mutate(dtype = ifelse(dataset %in% mocks, "Genus Count: Mock", "Genus Count: Simulation / Real"),
            exp = ifelse(dataset %in% reals, "Consensus", "Expected")) %>%
            filter(!pipeline %in% "LotuS2_otu")

    hlines <- tibble::tribble(
      ~dtype,   ~yintercept, ~color,              ~lt,
      "Genus Count: Mock",   18,          cols_d[["mock5"]],   "dotted",
      "Genus Count: Mock",   15,          cols_d[["mock12"]],  "dotted",
      "Genus Count: Simulation / Real",    282,         cols_d[["miseq_v4_sim"]],    "dashed",
      "Genus Count: Simulation / Real",    282,         cols_d[["novaseq_v4_sim"]],  "dotted"
    )

    p1 <- df_sub2 %>% 
      filter(!pipeline %in% "Expected") %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = pipeline, y = genus)) + 
      stat_summary(fun = "mean", geom = "bar", alpha = 0.5,
                  position = position_dodge(0.9),
                  color ="#D3D3D3", fill="#D3D3D3") +
      geom_line(aes(group = dataset, color = dataset)) +
      geom_point(aes(fill = dataset, color = dataset, shape = exp), size = 1.5) +
      facet_wrap(~dtype, scales="free") +
      geom_hline(
        data = hlines,
        aes(yintercept = yintercept, color = I(color), linetype = lt),
        linewidth = 0.3,
        inherit.aes = FALSE
      ) +
      my_theme(theme_classic) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = cols_d) +
      scale_color_manual(values = cols_d) + 
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 8),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "lightgrey", linewidth = 0.05)
      ) +
      guides(fill = "none", color = "none", shape = "none", linetype = "none") +
      scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
      labs(x = "", y = "# genera")

  df_avg <- df_sub2 %>% 
    group_by(dataset) %>% 
    summarize(avg = mean(genus, na.rm=TRUE)) 

  df_dev <- df_avg %>% 
      dplyr::left_join(., df_sub2 %>% filter(!pipeline %in% "Expected"), by = "dataset") %>% 
      mutate(perc_diff = (genus - avg) / avg) %>% 
      mutate(exp = ifelse(dataset %in% reals, "Consensus", "Expected"))
        
  p2 <- df_dev %>% 
    filter(!pipeline %in% c("Expected","LotuS2_otu")) %>%

    ggplot(., aes(x = pipeline, y = perc_diff)) +

                        guides = "collect") &
            theme(legend.position = "bottom",
                legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
                legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
                legend.key.width = unit(0.3, "cm"),
                legend.key.height = unit(0.4, "cm"))

    ggsave(paste0(plot_path, "Figure4_", lev, ".pdf"), plot =  combined, device = cairo_pdf, width = 12, height = 10)
}

```
